KOfo0zVfgBhhWGjT.description: Reginald is equipped with a cannon and hundreds of steel quills. He makes two steel quill attacks against every creature in a @Template[cone|distance:60], ignoring the multiple attack penalty until after all attacks are made. He can't use Quill Cannon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Quill Cannon]]{1d4 rounds}.

OF5xPm4it251t0zo.name: Reflective Plating
OF5xPm4it251t0zo.description: Reginald engages his defensive plating, which casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OOELvfkTedBMlWtq]{Spell Turning} on him (counteract modifier +32).

5inXNyZGoLUMii53.name: Slither
5inXNyZGoLUMii53.description: With his body composed of ink and gears, Reginald can move through tight spaces as if he were a Tiny creature, treating them as difficult terrain.

UUw22Ccx1nqHZgFR.name: Unbalancing Blow
UUw22Ccx1nqHZgFR.description: Any creature a grick critically hits is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against its attacks until the end of the grick's next turn.

YXf0epw5INfNsVTi.name: Vermicular Movement
YXf0epw5INfNsVTi.description: When a grick takes a Stride action to move half its Speed or less, that movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Vw3bmxYidV4ocAb1.name: Drain Wand
Vw3bmxYidV4ocAb1.description:
Frequency once per day

Requirements Scathka hasn't acted yet on their turn

Effect On their turn, Scathka casts one spell they've prepared and already cast this day without spending a spell slot. Scathka must still Cast the Spell and meet the spell's other requirements.

eIDlmbUtMfTc108y.name: Throw Shadow Blade
eIDlmbUtMfTc108y.description:
Requirement Scathka is wielding a dagger

Effect Scathka draws a shadowy glyph on the dagger's blade and flings it at a nearby foe. Scathka makes a ranged Strike with the dagger with the range increment to 30 feet.

If the Strike hits, it deals @Damage[8d6[cold]] damage (double damage on a critical success) and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:32] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of its next turn (or [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} on a critical failure).

The dagger loses its shadowy magic as soon as the attack is resolved.

Exploding Statue.name: Exploding Statue
Exploding Statue.desc (hazard): A hollow statue filled with explosives is connected to a trip wire running along the adjacent door.
Exploding Statue.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Safely Cut Wire|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) to safely cut the wire

KRYmDgL0v3sgSPhE.name: Explosion
KRYmDgL0v3sgSPhE.description:
Trigger A creature opens the northern door without first disabling the trip wire

Effect The statue explodes, spraying shrapnel to the west in a @Template[cone|distance:5] and dealing @Damage[(1d10+7)[piercing],1d10[fire]]{1d10+7 piercing and 1d10 fire} damage to all creatures in the affected area (@Check[reflex|dc:18|basic] save).

R1OmPKgnrpEPWGr6.name: Attack of Opportunity
R1OmPKgnrpEPWGr6.description:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

OF6N85WER1HxJgCK.name: Integrated Launcher
OF6N85WER1HxJgCK.description: A projectile launcher is integrated into a clockwork assassin's systems, containing 10 spinning blades and five smoke bombs. When the assassin is destroyed, the launcher and its ammunition are also destroyed.

yOvz4I15CCPk78ns.name: Smoke Vision
yOvz4I15CCPk78ns.description: The clockwork assassin ignores the concealed condition from smoke.

q4WljID3qrZ5Fpnr.name: Wind-Up
q4WljID3qrZ5Fpnr.description: For the clockwork assassin to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for 24 hours, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again. The assassin can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).A creature can attempt a [[/act disable-device dc=33]]{DC 33 Thievery} check to Disable a Device to wind the assassin down. For each success, the assassin loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the assassin is in standby mode.

mmdbAeOOVVjLALCx.name: Rapid Repair
mmdbAeOOVVjLALCx.description: The clockwork assassin spends 1 hour of its operational time to repair itself, regaining 25 Hit Points and refilling its integrated projectile launcher with 4 spinning blades (to a maximum of 10) and 2 smoke bombs (to a maximum of 5).

A7VgvFTQFpm1Cc79.name: Smoke Bomb Launcher
A7VgvFTQFpm1Cc79.description: The clockwork assassin launches a smoke bomb. A screen of thick, opaque smoke fills a @Template[burst|distance:10] within 60 feet of the clockwork assassin. Creatures within the area are concealed, and all other creatures are concealed to them. The smoke lasts for 1 minute or until dispersed by a strong wind.

Y7P7UpMZajGcxNz4.name: Sneak Attack
Y7P7UpMZajGcxNz4.description: The clockwork assassin's Strikes deal an additional 3d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

GtoDWNmX34925xMc.name: Unbalancing Blow
GtoDWNmX34925xMc.description: Creatures hit by the clockwork assassin's rapier hand Strike are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of the clockwork assassin's next turn.

5HdfiD2BmZU6LzvL.name: Whirlwind Strike
5HdfiD2BmZU6LzvL.description: The chopper makes a melee Strike against each enemy within melee reach. Its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.

A8r84vdl4zcvpCMg.name: Free Blade
A8r84vdl4zcvpCMg.description:
Trigger The ghaele ends its turn while unable to act or attempts a greatsword Strike that would take a circumstance or status penalty.

Effect A ghaele's blade is implacable in the pursuit of freedom, and its energies can overpower any effect that would interfere with its swordplay.

The ghaele attempts to counteract each effect that prevents it from making a greatsword Strike, gives it a penalty to its greatsword Strike, or prevents it from acting.

The ghaele can use this ability even if it's otherwise unable to act.

nqhGLlFeLoFFBN9g.name: Light Form
nqhGLlFeLoFFBN9g.description:
A ghaele's body is partially corporeal and partially composed of light, with a color corresponding to the elemental energy currently residing in its blade (see Choose Weakness).

It can move through solid objects but can't end its action within a solid object.

Tfnx5jxpKaKtZ7ES.name: Choose Weakness
Tfnx5jxpKaKtZ7ES.description:
A ghaele attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} about a foe they are facing.

If successful, they can change the elemental damage dealt by their greatsword and light ray to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic, usually to match the foe's weakness.

They can also change their energy resistance to any of these energy types (this can be a different type than for their attacks).

The choices remain until they next use Choose Weakness.

29elTy7XDcAju8yK.name: Ghaele's Gaze
29elTy7XDcAju8yK.description:
When a ghaele fixes their gaze upon a non-good creature, the creature is subjected to the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C]{Divine Decree} (@Check[will|dc:20|name:Divine Decree|traits:damaging-effect] save).

If it survives, the creature is temporarily immune to for 1 minute.

Gv8gIlACS3hfoYJF.name: Greater Holy Blade
Gv8gIlACS3hfoYJF.description: Any weapon becomes a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rvItjGQaYT7Luwtm]{+3} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.DH0kB9Wbr5pDeunX]{Holy} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.KCQRFvUgbyclvOGi]{Greater Striking} weapon while the ghaele wields it.

7qqes4mzlHueunJX.name: Deep Breath
7qqes4mzlHueunJX.description: A Shikwashim mercenary can hold their breath for 20 minutes.

SGQATSbzafV9SYlH.name: Coordinated Distraction
SGQATSbzafV9SYlH.description:
With a sharp whistle or wave of their hand, the mercenary distracts an opponent so one of the mercenary's allies can land a clean blow.

The mercenary chooses a target and an ally, both of whom must be within 30 feet of the mercenary. The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the first Strike the mercenary's ally makes on its next turn; if the ally doesn't Strike that target, the effect is lost.

Depending on how the mercenary distracts their foe, this action gains either the auditory or visual trait.

3N2FHMvzMRnvpsId.name: Human Hunter
3N2FHMvzMRnvpsId.description: A Shikwashim mercenary's multiple attack penalty for attacks against humans is -3 (-2 with an agile weapon) on their second attack per turn or -6 (-4 with an agile weapon) on their third or subsequent attack per turn.

1qQjPJIus3hZOUXY.name: Powerful Swipe
1qQjPJIus3hZOUXY.description:
The Shikwashim mercenary makes a melee Strike. If it hits, it deals an extra die of damage.

This counts as two attacks for the mercenary's multiple attack penalty.

ISXykb5wK1DoaIOw.name: Terrain Advantage
ISXykb5wK1DoaIOw.description: Non-lizardfolk creatures in difficult terrain and non-lizardfolk creatures that are in water and lack a Swim speed are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to a Shikwashim mercenary.

EKp5irpqgnTwEyjX.name: Backdrop
EKp5irpqgnTwEyjX.description: When a creature attempts to Strike a living mural and critically misses, the attacker hits the surface (a wall, canvas, or so on) behind the living mural. This can damage or break the weapon or surface.

6BA0nR5VEDa0Aw15.name: Surface-Bound
6BA0nR5VEDa0Aw15.description:
A living mural can move only along flat surfaces such as floors and walls. This allows it to end its movement wrapped around corners when on a continuous surface.

If the surface it's on is destroyed (such as a portrait hit by a fireball spell or a puddle being splashed), the mural takes [[/r {10d6}]]{10d6 damage} and is shunted to the nearest flat surface. If there is no flat surface within 5 feet, the living mural is destroyed.

6gBFZhqoL9eg2XDz.name: Collective Attack
6gBFZhqoL9eg2XDz.description:
The subjects depicted within the living mural all reach out at once to attack. The living mural makes a fist Strike against each target within range.

These attacks count toward the living mural's multiple attack penalty, but this penalty doesn't increase until after all of the attacks are made.

YE6DApvJToive72E.name: Paint the Masses
YE6DApvJToive72E.description:
The living mural expels a @Template[cone|distance:15] of paint.

Creatures in the area must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:41] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

The living mural can't use Paint the Masses again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Paint the Masses]]{1d4 rounds}.

snJ95Lkh1TmrNndQ.name: Splash of Color
snJ95Lkh1TmrNndQ.description: When the living mural hits with a splatter attack, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round.

AD2GrziGoOFfzrk7.name: Contingency Plan
AD2GrziGoOFfzrk7.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Kapral is targeted by an attack

Effect Kapral casts blink on herself.

1HjWqCIXUjmknlZE.name: Adamantine Strikes
1HjWqCIXUjmknlZE.description: Chaos Gulgamodh's body—including the appendages it uses to make melee Strikes—is made of adamantine.

268BBCle1rCc1g1d.name: Cannon Fusillade
268BBCle1rCc1g1d.description:
Chaos Gulgamodh unleashes a salvo of explosive blasts in a @Template[cone|distance:30]. Creatures in the area take @Damage[(10d10+20)[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic|options:area-effect] save).

On a failed save, a creature is subjected to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave} effect. On a critically failed save, a creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Chaos Gulgamodh can't use Cannon Fusillade again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Cannon Fusillade]]{1d4 rounds}.

Burning Chandelier Trap.name: Burning Chandelier Trap
Burning Chandelier Trap.desc (hazard): Four large flaming chandeliers swing wildly around the room.
Burning Chandelier Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:36|name:Disable a Chandelier|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to disable a chandelier or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 33) to permanently drain the magic from a chandelier. Any amount of cold damage that overcomes a chandelier's cold resistance extinguishes its flames and removes its persistent fire damage and flame dart attack. @Check[thievery|dc:41|name:Disable Trap (Control Panel)|traits:action:disable-a-device] (legendary) to disable the entire trap from the hidden control panel in the southeast corner of the room.
Burning Chandelier Trap.reset: The trap deactivates and resets 1 minute after there are no living creatures remaining in the room.
Burning Chandelier Trap.routine: (4 actions) For every chandelier disabled, the trap's actions are reduced by 1. For each of the trap's actions, a different chandelier attacks a random creature in the room. A chandelier uses its swinging chandelier attack if it can, but it can't make melee attacks against creatures in the cage, the closet, or the gap between the two double doors leading into the vault. Against a creature it can't reach with a melee attack, it uses a flame dart attack instead. The trap doesn't take multiple attack penalties.
Burning Chandelier Trap.stealth: (master) or @Check[perception|dc:38|traits:action:seek] (master) to spot the trap's control panel

wGuVhWBsG7ERdKlr.name: Extending Chandeliers
wGuVhWBsG7ERdKlr.description:
Trigger A creature touches the cage door, the closet door, or any wooden stand

Effect Both double doors leading out of the room shut and lock; while the trap is active, the key doesn't work to open these doors (although their locks can be picked normally). The chandeliers drop several feet on elongated chains, allowing them to swing around the room. The closest chandelier to the triggering creature makes a swinging chandelier Strike against it. The trap then rolls initiative.

Veksciralenix.name: Veksciralenix
Veksciralenix.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

KSyMhNnoclGuHxnZ.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

DrsLgW5tbXlYEqJ1.name: Alien Presence
DrsLgW5tbXlYEqJ1.description:
90 feet. A creature that first enters the area must attempt a @Check[will|dc:42] save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to the Veksciralenix's Alien Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

ikVC2siqOrYTYZtS.name: Second Chance
ikVC2siqOrYTYZtS.description:
Frequency three times per day

Trigger Veksciralenix or a creature that Veksciralenix can see attempts a check and learns the results

Effect The triggering creature rerolls the triggering check and takes the second result.

CVTZnv3ZcE4LbDPg.name: Breath Weapon
CVTZnv3ZcE4LbDPg.description:
The time dragon breathes in one of two ways.

The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

Storm The dragon breathes a burst of lightning in a @Template[cone|distance:50] that deals @Damage[20d6[electricity]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:42|basic|name:Storm Breath|options:area-effect] save).

Time Displacement (arcane, transmutation) The dragon breathes a time storm. Each creature within a @Template[cone|distance:50] must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:42|name:Time Displacement Breath|traits:transmutation] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 4}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 6}.

UAnT1rt4pcCFs6br.name: Draconic Frenzy
UAnT1rt4pcCFs6br.description: Veksciralenix makes two claw Strikes and one wing Strike in any order.

r47iaCjc2jC8iNnL.name: Draconic Momentum
r47iaCjc2jC8iNnL.description: Veksciralenix recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

9HOzCgOAKeHP5EhB.name: Venom Explosion
9HOzCgOAKeHP5EhB.description:
Trigger The venom mage is reduced to 0 Hit Points

Effect The venom mage explodes into a cloud of poison within a @Template[burst|distance:20]. The venom mage then reforms at a point they choose within the burst, avoids being knocked out, and remains at 1 Hit Point. The venom mage's wounded value increases by 1 when they use this ability, and they can't use this ability when they're wounded 3 or more. Creatures other than the venom mage within the burst must attempt a Fortitude save.

Critical Success No effect.

Success The creature is sickened 1.

Failure The creature is sickened 2 and cannot recover from the sickened condition while within 20 feet of the venom mage.

Critical Failure As failure, but sickened 4.

wazlV57b7ZEUGjn6.name: Steady Spellcasting
wazlV57b7ZEUGjn6.description: If another creature's reaction would disrupt the venom mage's spellcasting action, the venom mage attempts a @Check[flat|dc:15] check. If the venom mage succeeds, their action isn't disrupted.

Grabble Forden.name: Grabble Forden
Grabble Forden.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

i1fagw7VusZxwIdz.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

53IhzCwi4y8yO9XX.name: Drain Bonded Item
53IhzCwi4y8yO9XX.description:
Frequency 7 times per day

Requirements Grabble hasn't acted yet on this turn

Effect Grabble can cast one prepared spell he has already cast today without spending a spell slot. He must still Cast the Spell and meet the spell's other requirements. He can do this once per day for each of the spell ranks he can cast.

NILfejzFJ409TN4i.name: Poison Conversion
NILfejzFJ409TN4i.description:
Frequency 3 times per day

Effect If Grabble's next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is 6th rank or lower and deals acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage, the spell deals poison damage rather than its normal damage type and gains the poison trait.

Franca Laurentz.name: Franca Laurentz
Franca Laurentz.saves: +2 circumstance bonus to saves vs. poison

XVBhNwitUtia7zY6.name: +2 Circumstance Bonus on Saves vs. Poison

LQEhpFQTxwqQ8b2q.name: Deflective Dodge
LQEhpFQTxwqQ8b2q.description:
Trigger The attack roll for a Strike targeting Franca fails or critically fails

Effect Franca can choose to either Step or redirect the attack to a creature that is adjacent to her and within the reach of the triggering attack.

The attacker rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.

udFVDwS0vDvYW3tw.name: Bloody Rebel
udFVDwS0vDvYW3tw.description:
Franca quickly slashes at nearby foes, aiming to maim rather than disable. She makes up to three melee Strikes, each against a different creature within reach.

These Strikes count toward Franca's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after all three Strikes are made.

On a hit, the Strike deals @Damage[3[bleed]] damage instead of its normal damage.

On a critical hit, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the beginning of Franca's next turn or until they spend an action to remove the condition, whichever comes first.

oKdyZTnDb5xbqpF3.name: Hamstring
oKdyZTnDb5xbqpF3.description:
Requirements Franca's last action was a melee Strike that dealt sneak attack damage to an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} target

Effect Franca deals @Damage[6[bleed]] damage to the target creature, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}.

GrbNOULOdg2VBphU.name: Sneak Attack
GrbNOULOdg2VBphU.description: Franca's Strikes deal an additional 3d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

lVvJa2dDy1MeSjQ1.name: Splash Poison
lVvJa2dDy1MeSjQ1.description:
Franca uncorks and flings a dose of poison at a bleeding foe.

She retrieves a poison from her inventory, then splashes it at a creature within 10 feet that is currently taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Bleed Damage}.

The creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:32] save or be exposed to the poison.

Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).name: Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil)
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).desc (hazard): A summoning circle inlaid into the room's floor detects living creatures and summons a violent devil.
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).disable: @Check[perception|dc:18|name:Notice the Trap's Magic|traits:action:seek] to notice the trap's magic and avoid stepping on the floor outside the circle, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:21|name:Break Summoning Circle|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) to break the circle or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune
Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil).reset: The trap resets each day at dawn.

i0POO0dwNFDOcYuV.name: Summon Devil
i0POO0dwNFDOcYuV.description:
Trigger A living creature steps on any part of the floor not enclosed by the summoning circle

Effect One round after a creature touches the triggering area, the door to the room slams shut and locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{Thievery} checks to pick) and a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.FIoRPHaHdYUPVKdT]{Barbazu} devil appears in the summoning circle.

The devil rolls initiative and remains for [[/br 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6 rounds}, after which the spell ends and the devil disappears. The devil also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The summoned devil can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

pEr8VvYetu8yNn5t.name: Efficient Winding
pEr8VvYetu8yNn5t.description:
For the clockwork amalgam to act, it must be wound with a unique key by another creature. This takes 1 minute. Once wound, it remains operational for 7 days, after which time it becomes unaware of its surroundings and can't act until it's wound again.

The amalgam can enter standby mode as a 3-action activity. Its operational time doesn't decrease in standby, but it can sense its surroundings (with a -2 penalty to Perception). It can't act, with one exception: when it perceives a creature, it can exit standby as a reaction (rolling initiative if appropriate).

A creature can attempt a [[/act disable-device dc=33]]{DC 33 Thievery} check to Disable a Device to wind the amalgam down. For each success, the assassin loses 1 hour of operational time. This can be done even if the amalgam is in standby mode.

eosKGTfGo3nA3EVl.name: Recalibrate
eosKGTfGo3nA3EVl.description: The clockwork amalgam can recalibrate its internal structure to shed damaged components and replace them with new ones, restoring 125 HP to the construct. Each time it uses this ability, the clockwork amalgam permanently deactivates one of its five melee attacks as the components from that arm reassemble within the core of the machine.

Wbny5fScmVtKCw6w.name: Whirring Doom
Wbny5fScmVtKCw6w.description:
Frequency once per round

The clockwork amalgam becomes a blur of spinning weaponry. It makes up to five melee Strikes (one for each active melee attack it has available), taking a -4 penalty to the attack roll for each attack, but ignoring the multiple attack penalty until it has made all of its attacks. It can use each melee attack only once and it can target each creature in reach only once. If the clockwork amalgam used Whirring Doom in the previous round, it can use it again this round using only 1 action instead of 3. The amalgam's movement Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.

2zo8BFj6mkav8MPT.name: Ferocious Devotion
2zo8BFj6mkav8MPT.description:
When an illusory toady is destroyed, it dissolves into a puddle of cerulean quintessence before reforming to quasi-life once more. One round after it is destroyed, the toady starts re-forming. One round after that, the toady is completely healed and begins to fight once more.

If damaged while it is re-forming but before the process is complete, the toady is destroyed but splits into two cerulean puddles that begin re-forming into two identical toadies 1 round later, each with half the maximum HP of the original toady (this is similar to an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.uQBOJfjtzEXvpLQz]{Ochre Jelly's} Split ability); the toadies begin re-forming 1 round later.

The toadies are permanently destroyed only by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ihbRf964JDXztcy3]{Disjunction} or if @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.agents-of-edgewatch-bestiary.Actor.sUrJ7jxzBiJTbwVo]{Blune} falls unconscious.

92BXBHbmRG68ifPd.name: Amplify Spell
92BXBHbmRG68ifPd.description:
The toady wills itself to become a conduit for Blune's next spell, empowering the spell.

The toady becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until the beginning of its next turn.

If Blune Bandersworth is within 30 feet and Casts a Spell before the toady's next turn, the spell travels through the toady before redirecting toward its intended target.

The spell is heightened by 1 rank, to a maximum of 10th rank. The toady is then destroyed.

Supplicant Statues.name: Supplicant Statues
Supplicant Statues.desc (hazard): Six statues rapidly slide around the room on rollers, slowing down intruders and striking at them with spring-loaded sword arms.
Supplicant Statues.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:34|name:Disable Statue Rollers|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to disable a specific statue's rollers, or @Check[thievery|dc:39|name:Disable Trap (Control Panel)|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) on the control panel in A4 deactivates the whole trap. For each statue disabled, the trap loses 1 action from its routine and the DC for its predictive impediment ability decreases by 4. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank, counteract DC 32) doesn't harm the statues but removes the predictive impediment ability. Breaking the control panel prevents the trap from resetting.
Supplicant Statues.reset: The trap deactivates and resets one minute after the room is empty.
Supplicant Statues.routine: (6 actions) On the trap's initiative, each functioning statue slides up to 40 feet around the room and makes a statue shortsword Strike against an adjacent creature. The trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty, and the statues' movements don't trigger reactions.

pNlE1um147bT0E6P.name: Animated Statues
pNlE1um147bT0E6P.description:
Trigger A creature enters a square adjacent to a statue

Effect The trap makes a statue shortsword Strike against the triggering creature, activates its predictive impediment ability, and then rolls initiative.

x85871wfT5AGGHSb.name: Predictive Impediment
x85871wfT5AGGHSb.description: The statues continually slide around to bump into creatures and block their passage through the room. The first time on its turn that a creature attempts to move within the room, it must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:36] save or treat the entire room as difficult terrain for 1 round. On a critical failure, the creature is also knocked prone.

aBQGxKqOuBqF1FkF.name: Double Stab
aBQGxKqOuBqF1FkF.description:
Requirements Ralso is wielding two piercing weapons

Frequency once per round

Effect Ralso makes two Strikes against a single creature within reach, one Strike per weapon.

These attacks count toward Ralso's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks.

VsMHrDx86310JmtX.name: Sneak Attack
VsMHrDx86310JmtX.description: Ralso deals an extra 1d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

f6aAjLfElEhbsLCC.name: Dirty Bomb
f6aAjLfElEhbsLCC.description:
Requirements The chemist has at least one bomb in their possession

Effect The chemist adds a hasty mix of noxious substances to the bomb and makes a ranged Strike with it. If it hits and deals damage, the target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for [[/gmr 1d6 #rounds]]{1d6 rounds}; if the result of the save is a critical failure, this increases to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 3}. For the next 24 hours, the affected target takes a -2 circumstance penalty (-3 on a critical failure) to additional Fortitude saving throws against the same chemist's Crude Bombs.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.5ZK22sNW7o26aST0]{Effect: Dirty Bomb}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.ryY6fdqpC5Ztnagd]{Effect: Dirty Bomb (Critical Failure)}

2FxUvyDjnESqE9bl.name: Quick Brew
2FxUvyDjnESqE9bl.description:
Requirements The chemist has their alchemist's tools, formula book, and a free hand

Effect The chemist creates a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.SgtqZxt26BdjUmEB]{Moderate Acid Flask} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gWr4q4HiyGhETA8H]{Alchemist's Fire} that they must use before the end of their next turn or else it becomes inert.

Water Elemental Vessel (I2).name: Water Elemental Vessel (I2)
Water Elemental Vessel (I2).description: Spellcasters create elemental vessels by harvesting raw elemental energy and then binding it within a specially enchanted magic circle to grant it life.

N85UwJsuAe8nwuWV.name: Spell Circle
N85UwJsuAe8nwuWV.description: By performing an hour-long ritual, an elemental vessel can form a spell circle with an arcane or primal spellcaster. After the spell circle is formed, other spellcasters can join the spell circle by performing the same hour-long ritual while assisted by at least one spellcaster already in the spell circle. Each member of the spell circle must contribute at least one spell to the elemental vessel. The spellcaster permanently loses access to a spell slot equal to the spell's rank and the elemental vessel adds the contributed spell to its list of arcane innate spells (regardless of the spell's original type). An elemental vessel can be imbued with no more than three spells per spell rank. If the elemental vessel is destroyed, all members of the spell circle regain the spell slots they contributed to the creature. The arcane innate spells shown below represent a typical spell list for an elemental vessel, but each elemental vessel is likely to have different spells depending on what its spell circle has contributed.

fgprZ9vs1zfRUz3o.name: Dispel Vulnerability
fgprZ9vs1zfRUz3o.description: Whenever a creature successfully counteracts one of its spells, the vessel permanently loses access to that spell and takes damage equal to 4 × the spell's rank. The spell circle member who contributed that spell regains access to their contributed spell slot.

jJSKOhaRoCp1WwP4.name: Inhabit Vessel
jJSKOhaRoCp1WwP4.description: Any member of the elemental vessel's spell circle can spend 3 actions to mentally inhabit the vessel for 1 round. While they inhabit the vessel, the inhabiter controls the vessel's actions, and the vessel uses the inhabiter's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma modifiers for all checks. Only one creature can inhabit an elemental vessel at a time.

6pCE969IqFRVqLzJ.name: Engulf
6pCE969IqFRVqLzJ.description:
@Check[reflex|dc:35] save, no damage, [[/act escape dc=35]], Rupture 28

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

g8bRqHNpfEqsTYyx.name: Internal Spell Strike
g8bRqHNpfEqsTYyx.description: The elemental vessel targets an engulfed creature with one of its spells. The spell must have a range of touch.

7RZClAttcFohXVTd.name: Little Favors
7RZClAttcFohXVTd.description: Each time a creature willingly performs a service, quest, or task for the zealborn, the creature takes a cumulative -1 status penalty to saving throws against the zealborn's mental spells and abilities (maximum -4).

5izc2RKfDYtjIicX.name: Rejuvenation
5izc2RKfDYtjIicX.description: When a zealborn is destroyed, it re-forms, fully healed, near a follower of its choice in [[/gmr 1d10 #days]]{1d10 days}. For the purposes of rejuvenation, a follower is defined as an intelligent creature who's well acquainted with the zealborn and is a true believer in the zealborn's mission, not merely a lukewarm supporter. A zealborn can be permanently destroyed only if they have no current followers or can be convinced to end their own life.

EbIhMOd0cHtkhNcM.name: Zealous Restoration
EbIhMOd0cHtkhNcM.description: A zealborn can't regain Hit Points through resting or void healing; they feed only on the idealism of their supporters, regaining 10 Hit Points per day for each creature under the effects of a geas cast by the zealborn. Creatures under a zealborn's geas have their maximum HP reduced by 10 each day until they are burned away to a husk and perish. After 24 hours, such creatures rise as zeal-damned ghouls under the zealborn's control. Zeal-damned ghouls eat only the flesh of evil or chaotic creatures and deal an additional 1d6 spirit and 1d6 void damage with their attacks.

Vy9EtFybJQqo55xn.name: Hypnotic Glow
Vy9EtFybJQqo55xn.description: 30 feet. Similar to other will-o'-wisps, a gloaming will-o'-wisp is naturally invisible, but glows with a faint colored light. They cast dim light in the aura, which makes them visible. In addition, any non-aberration creature that ends their turn in the aura and can see the gloaming will-o'-wisp is distracted by the gloaming will-o'-wisp's glow and must attempt a @Check[will|dc:31] save. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round and takes @Damage[3d6[mental]] damage.

yAHJOd3dkfOae1Kf.name: Magic Immunity
yAHJOd3dkfOae1Kf.description: A will-o'-wisp is immune to all spells except @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HRb2doyaLtaoCfi3]{Faerie Fire}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.gKKqvLohtrSJj3BM]{Force Barrage}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary}.

Yb2OjQReLk3HgLoc.name: Feed on Fear
Yb2OjQReLk3HgLoc.description:
Requirement An enemy is under a fear effect or dying within 15 feet of the will-o'-wisp

Effect The will-o'-wisp feeds on the creature's terror. They regains 4d8 Hit Points, and if they've Gone Dark, their glow reignites. A will-o'-wisp can take this action only once per round.

T4zHj7DFiaCBwf6f.name: Go Dark
T4zHj7DFiaCBwf6f.description: The gloaming will-o'-wisp extinguishes their hypnotic glow, becoming @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. They can end this effect with another use of this action. If they use their shock attack while invisible, the arc of electricity lets any observer determine their location, making the will-o'-wisp only @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to observers until they move.

6u1eMdIQZV0dWPQU.name: Opportune Dodge
6u1eMdIQZV0dWPQU.description:
Trigger A creature critically fails a Strike against the Daemonic Rumormonger

Effect The Rumormonger dodges out of the way and uses his momentum to attack and move out of reach. He Strides up to 20 feet and can Strike at any point during this movement; this Strike counts toward the multiple attack penalty on his next turn.

qFILNq2kmX5xF0Dt.name: Black Ink Delirium
qFILNq2kmX5xF0Dt.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} (1 round)

a5d4jfdl2s8CiAsa.name: Breath of Lies
a5d4jfdl2s8CiAsa.description:
The Daemonic Rumormonger breathes a torrent of acidic sand and poisoned ink in an @Template[line|distance:80], dealing @Damage[6d12[acid],6d12[poison]|options:area-damage]{6d12 acid damage and 6d12 poison damage} and exposing victims to his black ink delirium.

He can't use Breath of Lies again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath of Lies]]{1d4 rounds}.

rZ6LtOq5W7Ef8R1W.name: Whirling Slashes
rZ6LtOq5W7Ef8R1W.description: The Daemonic Rumormonger Strides up to his Speed. He can make up to three claw Strikes, each against a different target, at any points during this Stride. His multiple attack penalty applies as usual.

0DxZM2ZhwpKrUolW.name: Sneak Attack
0DxZM2ZhwpKrUolW.description: The Copper Hand illusionist deals 2d6 additional precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

The Winder.name: The Winder
The Winder.desc (hazard): A large metallic arm, 20 feet long, is set into the floor. It rotates around the room to wind up nearby clockwork creatures.
The Winder.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:50|name:Deactivate System|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to deactivate the system, or @Check[athletics|dc:40|name:Jam Gears] (legendary) to jam the gears for 1 round
The Winder.reset: The Winder resets as soon as no creatures remain in the room.
The Winder.routine: (1, 2, or 4 actions, depending on the encounter's threat level) The Winder uses each of its actions to Wind clockwork assassins in the room, starting with inactive ones.

Wc0IrjjTSicQkUfW.name: Wind Up
Wc0IrjjTSicQkUfW.description:
Trigger A creature other than the Rumormonger enters the room, or the Rumormonger commands the device to activate

Effect The Winder rolls initiative.

IlMxWLhPQQrxWb4s.name: Wind
IlMxWLhPQQrxWb4s.description: The Winder winds a clockwork creature in the room. If the creature is currently inactive, this activates the creature, allowing it to act normally for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}. If already active, this instead increases the number of rounds the clockwork creature remains active by 1d4.

Hestriviniaas.name: Hestriviniaas
Hestriviniaas.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

4Wo8cEyKXFYXahnb.name: Entropy Sense (Imprecise) 60 feet
4Wo8cEyKXFYXahnb.description:
Hestriviniaas can anticipate the most likely presence of a creature through a supernatural insight into chaotic probabilities and chance. This grants it the ability to sense creatures within the listed range.

A creature under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} or that is otherwise shielded from divinations and predictions cannot be noticed via entropy sense.

nK4PUmUsKj5XejH3.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

wKQPyzZESm0w8vni.name: Protean Anatomy 25
wKQPyzZESm0w8vni.description:
Hestriviniaas' vital organs shift and change shape and position constantly. Immediately after the Hestriviniaas takes acid, electricity, or sonic damage, it gains the listed amount of resistance to that damage type.

This lasts for 1 hour or until the next time the protean takes damage of one of the other types (in which case its resistance changes to match that type), whichever comes first. The keketar is immune to polymorph effects unless it is a willing target.

If @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, the keketar automatically recovers at the end of its next turn as new sensory organs grow to replace the compromised ones.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.c6SiBB3mzV8lZUQr]{Effect: Protean Anatomy}

79KeB3EaNuz3Wjd2.name: Spatial Riptide
79KeB3EaNuz3Wjd2.description:
30 feet. A creature using a teleportation ability within the aura or arriving in it via teleportation must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:45] save or wink out of existence for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds} before completing the teleport. The creature can't act, sense anything, or be targeted. On a successful save, the creature completes the teleport normally but is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Keketars are immune to this effect.

nO9dKSqf8ZjJRuCy.name: Change Shape
nO9dKSqf8ZjJRuCy.description:
Hestriviniaas can take the appearance of any Gargantuan or smaller creature. This doesn't change its Speed or its attack and damage bonuses with its Strikes, but might change the damage type its Strikes deal.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

0tqsvUhGYvPuB2ga.name: Reshape Reality
0tqsvUhGYvPuB2ga.description: When Hestriviniaas casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage}, it infuses the illusion with quasi-real substance. Creatures that do not disbelieve the illusion treat structures and terrain created through the spell as though they were real, ascending illusory stairs, becoming trapped by illusory quicksand, and so on.

laNWVOBt5DoTHn3G.name: Warpwave Strike
laNWVOBt5DoTHn3G.description: A creature struck by Hestriviniaas' jaws or claw Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:45] save or be subject to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave}.

Explosive Barrels.name: Explosive Barrels
Explosive Barrels.desc (hazard): Wooden barrels marked with an oil-drop symbol catch fire and explode.
Explosive Barrels.disable: @Check[survival|dc:20|name:Smother the Flames] to smother the flames without rupturing the barrels

QP06eTmf8XusaVPV.name: Explode
QP06eTmf8XusaVPV.description:
Trigger 4 rounds pass after the agents' arrival without anyone smothering them

Effect The barrels explode, dealing @Damage[(3d6+8)[fire]] damage to everything within a 20-foot radius (@Check[reflex|dc:20|basic|traits:fire] save).

ykHarPFAY9t176Uv.name: Attack of Opportunity
ykHarPFAY9t176Uv.description:
Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

iYdGVR75KvoZWFO3.name: Toxic Mastery
iYdGVR75KvoZWFO3.description: Kalyn can masterfully manipulate vile, poisonous energy and increase its potency. Her melee and ranged Strikes deal an additional 2d6 poison damage, and a target that takes this poison damage has a -1 status penalty to saving throws against Kalyn's divine spells for 1 round. Poisons delivered by Kalyn have the virulent trait.

Ixusoth.name: Ixusoth
Ixusoth.saves: +2 status to all saves vs. magic

rY3uWiPQqOCSmYTu.name: Lore Master
rY3uWiPQqOCSmYTu.description: Ixusoth retains a vast amount of knowledge. She can use her Bardic Lore skill to Recall Knowledge on any topic, and she knows any languages common to an area she has spent a day or more in.

niqal0ySwUPyqG0P.name: Eye Probe
niqal0ySwUPyqG0P.description:
Frequency once per day

Up to six of Ixusoth's eyes detach from her body. Each eye has AC 26, HP 1, and a fly speed of 40 feet. Ixusoth can see through all of her eye probes. She can move the probes all in separate directions using a single action. Ixusoth can have no more than six eye probes active at a time; using this ability to create more eyes causes the eye or eyes farthest away to shrivel and die.

Ixusoth can deliver touch spells through her eye probes and make melee spell attacks through them. In addition, she can Steal Memories through an eye probe using a single action by touching the target with the eye.

QURekRpCFthbGcMS.name: Scatterbrain Palm
QURekRpCFthbGcMS.description:
A creature hit by Ixusoth's fist Strike must attempt a @Check[will|dc:36|options:inflicts:stunned] save. The creature is then temporarily immune until the start of its next turn.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3}, and the hyakume can use Steal Memories on the target as part of this action.

8j0TGPf1kZlcIwpn.name: Steal Memories
8j0TGPf1kZlcIwpn.description: Ixusoth reaches out with her mind and attempts to steal memories from a creature within 30 feet. The target must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:40] saving throw or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} and have some of its memories stolen. When Ixusoth steals memories, she learns some of the creature's memories (chosen by the GM). These memories are then lost to that creature.

Carvey.name: Carvey
Carvey.description: Made of odd scraps of skin and muscle, a flesh golem is a grotesque parody of life. Though it has no mind, it can still go into a berserk rage when harmed, giving it a faint semblance of emotion. Flesh golems guard the laboratories and charnel houses of fleshwarpers and necromancers who feel no compunctions about desecrating corpses for their own ends. Though the first flesh golem is believed to have been a misguided attempt to create from simple base elements, these monstrosities are far from human. In isolated cases, echoes of a personality might rise in a flesh golem if the brain used as part of its construction belonged to a particularly powerful personality, but such tragic instances are rare in the extreme.

X7yV3UIdROaskajA.name: Suicidal Obedience
X7yV3UIdROaskajA.description:
Carvey is unerringly loyal to the Skinsaw cult and to Mobana especially. When Carvey goes berserk, she doesn't attack the nearest living creature or object but instead moves adjacent to the creature nearest the balcony (or similar falling hazard, if the battle is taking place elsewhere) and attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} the creature over the cliff's edge.

The number of feet Carvey can Shove a creature is doubled as long as Carvey has 40 or fewer HP (thus, she pushes a creature 10 feet on a sucessful check and 20 feet on a critical success), but she must move the same distance and in the same direction as the pushed creature.

If the shoved creature falls over the cliff's edge, so does Carvey.

95kvqPPSJNio8vAK.name: Berserk
95kvqPPSJNio8vAK.description:
A severely damaged flesh golem has a chance of going berserk.

If it has 40 or fewer HP at the start of its turn, the golem must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] check or go berserk. A berserk golem wildly attacks the nearest living creature, or the nearest object if no creatures are nearby.

Hss992fc1sCOcDVo.name: Electric Reflexes
Hss992fc1sCOcDVo.description:
Trigger The golem takes electricity damage and a creature is adjacent to it.

Effect The golem lashes out and tries to grab a nearby creature. The golem attempts an Athletics check to [[/act grapple]] an adjacent creature. The creature also takes @Damage[3d6[electricity]] damage on a success, or @Damage[6d6[electricity]] damage on a critical success.

Q4P1CH4AQAlYpZ0X.name: Golem Antimagic
Q4P1CH4AQAlYpZ0X.description:
Harmed by fire (@Damage[5d8[untyped]], @Damage[3d4[untyped]] from areas or persistent damage); healed by electricity (area @Damage[2d4[healing]] HP); slowed by cold

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

uzwUjI3gD8tO8Chh.name: Vulnerable to Flesh to Stone
uzwUjI3gD8tO8Chh.description: Casting a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.znv4ECL7ZtuiagtA]{Petrify} spell on the flesh golem affects the golem normally.

hvTnI184eIoLfwPq.name: Berserk Slam
hvTnI184eIoLfwPq.description:
Requirement The flesh golem is berserk.

Effect The flesh golem Strikes with its fist at a -1 circumstance penalty. If it hits, it deals 1d6 extra damage and knocks the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Sordesdaemon.name: Sordesdaemon
Sordesdaemon.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

aqhyDgyM7LmIL9o2.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

8QnTTWcdqDNyOtIl.name: Miasma of Pollution
8QnTTWcdqDNyOtIl.description:
30 feet. Creatures in the aura can't reduce the value of the sickened condition.

A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn in it must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:34] save or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} (plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} as long as it is sickened on a critical failure).

A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Creatures made of water (such as water elementals) and plant creatures use an outcome one degree of success worse than the result of their save.

ztgpLrKdJjctex5J.name: Pollution Infusion
ztgpLrKdJjctex5J.description:
Non-fiend creatures adjacent to the afflicted creature take a -1 circumstance penalty to saving throws against disease

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:36]

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 day)

Stage 4 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 week)

Stage 5 dead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.gORyINQLvplfthlm]{Effect: Pollution Infusion}

wW8lBy7vi5CcDHTN.name: Retch of Foulness
wW8lBy7vi5CcDHTN.description:
The sordesdaemon exhales a spray of sewage that deals @Damage[8d6[acid],8d6[poison]|options:area-damage]{8d6 acid damage and 8d6 poison damage} in a @Template[cone|distance:30] (@Check[fortitude|dc:40|basic|options:area-effect] save).

It can't use Retch of Foulness again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Retch of Foulness]]{1d4 rounds}.

Prospecti Statue.name: Prospecti Statue
Prospecti Statue.description: As with any humanoid animated statues of Medium size, giant animated statues are used to guard locations of importance, but their increased size and power make them most useful in large vaults, spacious chambers, or outdoor locations. Animated objects of this strength and size are ideal for tasks and responsibilities usually performed by golems, and more powerful animated objects are thus all but unheard of.

FHYZijWKqxyPWq4b.name: Construct Armor (Hardness 10)
FHYZijWKqxyPWq4b.description: Like normal objects, a giant animated statue has Hardness. This Hardness reduces any damage it takes by an amount equal to the Hardness. Once a giant animated statue is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, or immediately upon being damaged by a critical hit, its construct armor breaks and its Armor Class is reduced to 22.

M203mlcBNFvAqyIJ.name: Stone Robes
M203mlcBNFvAqyIJ.description:
The Prospecti statue turns suddenly, causing its robes, which flow like fabric despite being as hard as stone, to swing about and damage opponents.

Creatures adjacent to the animated statue take @Damage[(2d6+6)[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:25|basic] save; on a critical failure, the creature is also knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}).

Tiderunner Aquamancer.name: Tiderunner Aquamancer
Tiderunner Aquamancer.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. enchantments, -2 to all saves vs. aboleth effects

22ts3ClOQFeLq0Jt.name: Water Shield
22ts3ClOQFeLq0Jt.description: The aquamancer is surrounded by a bubble of water that buffers attacks. Each round, the shield absorbs the first 25 damage that would be dealt to the aquamancer. The shield can absorb only bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, acid, cold, and fire damage types. The aquamancer can dismiss or raise their shield by spending a single action.

igIwGgzOBvjtlLdx.name: Transparent
igIwGgzOBvjtlLdx.description:
A slithering rift is so clear that it's difficult to spot. A successful @Check[perception|dc:48] check is required to notice a stationary slithering rift, and a creature must be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Searching} to attempt this check.

A creature that walks into the rift's space might fall into any pit currently in effect due to Dimensional Pit.

nyahaCV93O7YYyau.name: Breach Vulnerability
nyahaCV93O7YYyau.description:
Ingesting an extradimensional space like that found in a bag of holding deals @Damage[12d8[force]] damage to the slithering rift and its occupants.

The slithering rift then immediately uses Out You Go.

M7E6dxLskMLaX43G.name: Dimensional Pit
M7E6dxLskMLaX43G.description:
The slithering rift opens an extradimensional, 20-foot-deep pit that covers its own space and all adjacent squares unless they are walls or similarly blocking terrain.

Any other creature occupying spaces in the pit must succeed at a @Check[reflex|dc:40|traits:damaging-effect] save or fall into the pit, taking damage from the fall (typically @Damage[10[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage). Any creature grabbed by the ooze is released from the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-ability-glossary-srd.Item.i18TlebMzwONyPhI]{Grab} and falls in, even if it was outside the pit squares.

While the pit is open, the slithering rift is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and can't be forced to move. It can make pseudopod Strikes originating from the walls of the pit. A creature that starts its turn at the bottom of the pit takes @Damage[5d6[acid]] damage.

Creatures can climb the walls with a @Check[athletics|dc:40|name:Climb Out of the Rift|traits:action:climb] check. When the slithering rift dies, the pit closes and creatures inside are ejected, as Out you Go.

zvkxJ9ZreNjX3yJL.name: Flurry of Pods
zvkxJ9ZreNjX3yJL.description:
The slithering rift makes a single pseudopod Strike against each target within range it hasn't already @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}.

These attacks count toward the slithering rift's multiple attack penalty, but this penalty doesn't increase until after all of these attacks.

IH1SiADzFCDakX8w.name: Out You Go
IH1SiADzFCDakX8w.description:
The slithering rift closes all pit spaces it created using Dimensional Pit, ejecting all its occupants onto the ground into random free spaces where the opening of the pit was.

Each occupant takes @Damage[9d6[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:40|basic] save).

glyWTuwYyEk8AaC1.name: Dubious Shifting
glyWTuwYyEk8AaC1.description:
The zrukbat assumes the shape of any Small object or ornamentation, although the zrukbat's mimicked objects usually have unrealistic or suspicious quirks.

This doesn't change the zrukbat's size but can alter their coloration and visual appearance.

They have an automatic result of 23 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as the mimicked object.

ekdPtlR0pjDVDM4T.name: Go for the Eyes
ekdPtlR0pjDVDM4T.description:
The zrukbat flies up to its Speed and makes a claw Strike at the end of its move.

If the claw attack hits, the target must succeed on a @Check[fortitude|dc:15] saving throw or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round (or blinded for 1 minute on a critical failure). If the Strike was a critical hit, the target's save result is one degree of success worse.

9hvKp9EJbq6Log0q.name: Consume Flesh
9hvKp9EJbq6Log0q.description:
Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of an evil or chaotic creature that died within the last hour.

Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains @Damage[6d6[healing]] Hit Points. It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

j72OO3UZ0KrTLLO6.name: Ghoul Fever
j72OO3UZ0KrTLLO6.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:27]

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d6[void]] damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a zeal-damned ghoul the next midnight.

QSKXWJ8br4qwHbtf.name: Paralysis
QSKXWJ8br4qwHbtf.description: Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed}. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

PJdaCe5La2FhB5AN.name: Swift Leap
PJdaCe5La2FhB5AN.description: The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.

Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).name: Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat)
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).desc (hazard): An invisible cloud of magical sensors detects living creatures in the room and summons fire elementals to slay the creatures.
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:22|name:Approach Rune] (trained) to approach without triggering the trap, followed by @Check[thievery|dc:22|name:Erase Summoning Rune|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) to erase the rune or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract the rune
Summoning Rune (Cinder Rat).reset: The trap resets each day at dawn.

oXzm9KqLtbgKvm14.name: Summon Elementals
oXzm9KqLtbgKvm14.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the room

Effect Two rounds after a creature enters the room, the room's door slams shut and locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{Thievery} checks to pick), and two @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.xN5J9S485LxFZMkL]{Cinder Rat} fire elementals emerge from the floor.

The elementals roll initiative and remain for [[/gmr 3d6 #rounds]]{3d6 rounds}, after which the spell ends and the creatures disappear. The elementals also disappear if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The summoned elementals can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.

Izfiitar.name: Izfiitar
Izfiitar.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

aJI86W6ShmBc7gPN.name: Entropy Sense (Imprecise) 120 feet
aJI86W6ShmBc7gPN.description:
A Izfiitar can anticipate the most likely location of a creature through their supernatural insight into the forces of chaotic probabilities and chance. This grants the izflitar the ability to sense creatures within the listed range.

The izflitar's entropy sense doesn't detect creatures under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} or that are otherwise shielded from divinations and predictions.

LwT2M56UrXw3fIUM.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

JXIun04dusvrOS6n.name: Kiss of the Speakers
JXIun04dusvrOS6n.description:
The izfiitar continuously tinkers with the myriad possibilities in which it can move or manipulate magic.

The izfiitar is always @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} and can use the extra action only to Cast a Spell, Step, or Stride.

o03yd3s67EeP9WOh.name: Prescient Revision
o03yd3s67EeP9WOh.description:
Trigger The izfiitar fails a check

Effect The izfiitar rerolls the triggering check and takes the better result.

For [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}, it loses the effects of Kiss of the Speakers and can't use Reshape Reality.

UOmYO7g7ej3NwdzH.name: Protean Anatomy 25
UOmYO7g7ej3NwdzH.description:
A izfiitar's vital organs shift and change shape and position constantly. Immediately after the izfiitar takes acid, electricity, or sonic damage, it gains the listed amount of resistance to that damage type. This lasts for 1 hour or until the next time the protean takes damage of one of the other types (in which case its resistance changes to match that type), whichever comes first.

The izfiitar is immune to polymorph effects unless it is a willing target. If @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, the izfiitar automatically recovers at the end of its next turn as new sensory organs grow to replace the compromised ones.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.c6SiBB3mzV8lZUQr]{Effect: Protean Anatomy}

9m6cGcYmQptppNHf.name: Change Shape
9m6cGcYmQptppNHf.description:
The izfiitar takes the appearance of any Huge or smaller creature. This doesn't change its Speed or its attack and damage bonuses with its Strikes, but might change the damage type its Strikes deal.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

8xAxPvW0rww5NovC.name: Greater Warpwave Strike
8xAxPvW0rww5NovC.description:
Any creature struck and damaged by an izfiitar's jaws or claw Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:42] save or be subject to a particularly powerful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave}.

Roll twice and apply both affects, rerolling any duplicates.

BsQZslLQ0FJcYne3.name: Reshape Reality
BsQZslLQ0FJcYne3.description: When the izfiitar casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.HBJPsonQnWcC3qdX]{Mirage}, it infuses the illusion with quasi-real substance. Creatures that do not disbelieve the illusion treat structures and terrain created through the spell as though they were real, ascending illusory stairs, becoming trapped by illusory quicksand, and so on.

XEmgx6gs9UBM9Fqd.name: Storm of Claws
XEmgx6gs9UBM9Fqd.description: The izfiitar makes up to six claw Strikes, each against a different target.

Ctkj7r3YYAFSQEKx.name: Disgorge Portal
Ctkj7r3YYAFSQEKx.description:
The camarach vomits a spray of coruscating light. This has the effect of a DC 42 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.d6o52BnjViNz7Gub]{Prismatic Spray}, except that each creature is affected by one violet beam and one other beam (roll 1d6 instead of 1d8 to determine which other beam).

The camarach can't Disgorge a Portal again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Disgorge a Portal]]{1d4 rounds}.

wjucZTZEvK64kwlz.name: Exile
wjucZTZEvK64kwlz.description:
The camarach shunts one creature within its body through an inner portal to send it away.

The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:38] save.

Critical Success The creature is teleported to an open space it chooses within 30 feet of the camarach.

Success The creature isn't teleported.

Failure The creature is teleported to a random open space 1 mile from the camarach.

Critical Failure The creature is teleported to a random other plane, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5bTt2CvYHPvaR7QQ]{Interplanar Teleport}.

LvmDMsbTpm0IyK9u.name: Fast Swallow
LvmDMsbTpm0IyK9u.description:
Trigger The camarach Grabs a creature

Effect The camarach uses Swallow Whole.

nurJkCpZvHiPZo76.name: Project False Image
nurJkCpZvHiPZo76.description: When the camarach casts project image, its illusory image can be another creature of its size or a structure of its size that features a large portal (such as a freestanding archway or a large hut with an open doorway).

9ShSRecAk97rJkLS.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
9ShSRecAk97rJkLS.description: Tyrroicese can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

GnvMkeIBg6ZpYXzJ.name: Pseudopod Burst
GnvMkeIBg6ZpYXzJ.description:
Tyrroicese makes up to three pseudopod strikes, each against a different creature.

Tyrroicese's multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all these attacks are made.

haax0MkiNqA6MN2L.name: Rallying Call
haax0MkiNqA6MN2L.description:
When Tyrroicese subsumed Corporal Quordein, it gained a perverted form of the commander's ability to rally allies.

The first time Tyrroicese uses this ability, it summons an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-bestiary.Actor.uQBOJfjtzEXvpLQz]{Ochre Jelly}, which leaks out of the ceiling of area D13 and drops to the floor to join the fight, siding with Tyrroicese.

Thereafter, when Tyrroicese uses this ability, any oozes within 60 feet become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 round (the oozes can use their extra action only to Stride) and, if they're not allied with the agents, the oozes ally themselves with Tyrroicese.

RQ0R47s8yyK8gYS8.name: Stretching Step
RQ0R47s8yyK8gYS8.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect Tyrroicese forcefully extends a sticky pseudopod, plants it on a wall within 45 feet, and retracts the muscle.

Tyrroicese springs over to a space adjacent to the wall, moving through the intervening squares as normal but ignoring any difficult or greater difficult terrain.

bi6VcgRWUdub6hl4.name: Subsume
bi6VcgRWUdub6hl4.description:
Tyrroicese lifts an adjacent dying creature with its pseudopods and subsumes that creature into its own oozy flesh. The subsumed creature's dying value does not increase, though it can't decrease either.

Tyrroicese regains @Damage[30[healing]] HP and also gains the ability to use one or two of the subsumed creature's special abilities or feats, subject to the GM's discretion.

A creature adjacent to Tyrroicese can extract a subsumed creature by spending 2 actions to attempt a @Check[athletics|dc:29|name:Extract Subsumed Creature] check.

On a success, the subsumed creature is pulled from Tyrroicese and falls into the nearest available space.

kEiDcm42Prsww2ja.name: Alchemical Reaction
kEiDcm42Prsww2ja.description:
Trigger The alchemical horror takes damage from an alchemical bomb

Effect The volatile substances that compose the alchemical horror froth outward as they react with the bomb. The bomb's full effects affect creatures in every space within 15 feet of the alchemical horror, and splash damage affects creatures 5 feet beyond that.

F0wNdQAwukZzTRRS.name: Alchemical Torrent
F0wNdQAwukZzTRRS.description:
The alchemical horror spews a torrent of alchemical fluids in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that deals @Damage[20d6[acid]|options:area-damage] damage to creatures in the area (@Check[reflex|dc:43|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The alchemical horror can't use this ability again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Alchemical Torrent]]{1d4 rounds}.

Nenchuuj.name: Nenchuuj
Nenchuuj.saves: +2 status to all saves vs. magic

2wSPUQgCOkfTQCUJ.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

LBQk96wXoxYrTUZi.name: Distort Magic
LBQk96wXoxYrTUZi.description:
Trigger A creature targets the nenchuuj with a spell

Effect The nenchuuj warps the creature's magic, attempting an Arcana check to counteract the spell. If successful, the nenchuuj can instead redirect the spell, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OOELvfkTedBMlWtq]{Spell Turning}, onto the caster or onto a different target within range from the caster.

bZAhdsbYFuZ2syFl.name: Easy to Call
bZAhdsbYFuZ2syFl.description: The sahkil is considered 2 levels lower for the purposes of being summoned by rituals (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.2ykmAVKrsAWcazcC]{Binding Circle}), but is always free to attack or leave instead of negotiate unless the primary caster's check is a critical success.

LvYtP53GFOEynRGV.name: Skip Between
LvYtP53GFOEynRGV.description: The sahkil can move itself between the Ethereal Plane and the Material Plane, as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.D2nPKbIS67m9199U]{Ethereal Jaunt}, except that this ability has an unlimited duration and can be Dismissed.

Hq1vagZwNS6eDSNA.name: Tainted Backlash
Hq1vagZwNS6eDSNA.description:
A creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened} by the sahkil's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.O6VQC1Bs4aSYDa6R]{Mask of Terror} is gripped with fear of the ways magic can go wrong.

The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 2} for as long as it is frightened. If the creature Casts a Spell during its turn, it can't reduce its frightened condition at the end of that turn.

TfGlX9oclwIPR62r.name: Toxin-Inured
TfGlX9oclwIPR62r.description: A poison eater can't gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened} condition from poisons.

RiF9Uw43dbvL8TEa.name: Consume Poison
RiF9Uw43dbvL8TEa.description:
The poison eater uses an Interact action to draw a dose of poison and eats it, gaining strength.

The poison-eater's Strikes deal two weapon dice of damage rather than one. The poison eater is affected by the consumed poison normally and, therefore, usually chooses poisons mitigated by their poison resistance and toxin-inured ability.

At the end of each of their turns, the poison eater attempts a @Check[flat|dc:17|name:Consumed Poison Metabolizes] check; on a success, this ability ends.

C8jCG9WTW2fP6H0b.name: Poison Frenzy
C8jCG9WTW2fP6H0b.description:
Requirements The poison eater isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.HL2l2VRSaQHu9lUw]{Fatigued} or already in a frenzy

Trigger the poison eater damages a creature while Consume Poison is in effect

Effect The poison eater flies into a frenzy that lasts for 1 minute. While in a frenzy, the poison eater gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls with melee Strikes, gains a +4 status bonus to damage rolls with melee Strikes, gains 20 temporary Hit Points until the end of the frenzy, and takes a -2 status penalty to AC. The poison eater can't voluntarily end their frenzy. After their frenzy, the poison eater is fatigued.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.u2z1BgpZsxl7Zc2z]{Effect: Poison Frenzy}

OfYcuvZbwxbjF6cG.name: Vein Walker
OfYcuvZbwxbjF6cG.description: The excorion moves about by way of hundreds of pulsating blood vessels, which stretch from its body in dozens of tight, ropy bundles and anchor it to the ground. An excorion cannot be Tripped, Shoved, or otherwise forcibly moved except by magic, and the excorion ignores difficult terrain (but not greater difficult terrain).

qCVeUkgwYXq7lu8z.name: Bloody Handprint
qCVeUkgwYXq7lu8z.description: The excorion plants a magical handprint on the target, marking them as chosen for death. The excorion makes a fist Strike against an adjacent creature; this does not count toward the excorion's multiple attack penalty. On a hit, the attack does no damage, but the creature becomes observed to every excorion within 60 feet, even if an excorion's line of sight would be blocked by a wall or other obstacle. This effect lasts until the handprint is washed off, which requires water and spending 3 actions to fully clean off.

yTV624ydUotNS7Qa.name: Vital Transfusion
yTV624ydUotNS7Qa.description:
Requirements The excorion has at least 70 Hit Points

Effect The excorion sacrifices itself and transfers its bloody, vital energy to a willing living creature within 30 feet. The excorion is immediately destroyed, and the targeted living creature heals a number of HP equal to half the excorion's remaining HP at the time that it used this ability.

The living creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} during its next turn as its body adjusts to the newly transfused blood and vital energy; the living creature also counts as an excorion for 1 minute for the purpose of seeing other excorions' Bloody Handprint marks.

MIGvbijvRTovVpJE.name: Vomit Blood
MIGvbijvRTovVpJE.description: The excorion spews necrotic blood all over a foe it has grabbed. The grabbed creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:25] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

Miogimo.name: Miogimo
Miogimo.saves: +1 status bonus to Will saves vs. mental effects

5qAf1qV6aq6q3pQl.name: Little Favors
5qAf1qV6aq6q3pQl.description: Each time a creature willingly performs a service, quest, or task for the zealborn, the creature takes a cumulative -1 status penalty to saving throws against the zealborn's mental spells and abilities (maximum -4).

CcCVlFjqLYk2DTlc.name: +1 Status to Will Saves vs. Mental

7kep2BZKcI8m29QV.name: Rejuvenation
7kep2BZKcI8m29QV.description: When Miogimo is destroyed, he re-forms, fully healed, near a follower of his choice in [[/gmr 1d10 #Rejuvenation]]{1d10 days}. For the purposes of rejuvenation, a follower is defined as an intelligent creature who's well acquainted with Miogimo and is a true believer in Miogimo's mission, not merely a lukewarm supporter. Miogimo can be permanently destroyed only if he has no current followers or can be convinced to end his own life.

mNgkZuWHNH6FJsSb.name: Trickster's Ace
mNgkZuWHNH6FJsSb.description:
Trigger An effect would cause Miogimo to become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} or would slow his movement

Effect Miogimo casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.aqRYNoSvxsVfqglH]{Unfettered Movement} on himself.

ZoDu12928nPzUoAD.name: Zealous Restoration
ZoDu12928nPzUoAD.description: Miogimo can't regain Hit Points through resting or void healing; he feeds only on the idealism of his supporters, regaining 10 Hit Points per day for each creature under the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Q690d3mw3TUrKX7E]{Geas} cast by Miogimo. Creatures under Miogimo's geas have their maximum HP reduced by 10 each day until they are burned away to a husk and perish. After 24 hours, such creatures rise as zeal-damned ghouls under Miogimo's control. Zeal-damned ghouls eat only the flesh of evil or chaotic creatures and deal an additional 1d6 spirit and 1d6 void damage with their attacks.

Hands Of The Forgotten.name: Hands Of The Forgotten
Hands Of The Forgotten.desc (hazard): Ethereal hands stretch out from the walls and floor, attempting to restrain nearby creatures.
Hands Of The Forgotten.disable: @Check[religion|dc:30|name:Exorcise Spirits] (master) to exorcise the spirits or @Check[intimidation|dc:32|name:Scare Away the Hands|traits:action:demoralize] (expert) to scare away the hands

pWqtIfqDJ0Fag2CW.name: Waylay
pWqtIfqDJ0Fag2CW.description:
Trigger A creature moves into the area marked on the map

Effect Misty blue hands stretch out from the hallway's stone tiles and grasp at the triggering creature, which must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:26|traits:damaging-effect] save to avoid becoming hindered or harmed by the ethereal hands.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round and takes @Damage[(2d10+10)[void]] damage.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} for 1 round and takes @Damage[(4d10+15)[void]] damage.

ZJvsVjbPWteUphTK.name: Concussive Beatdown
ZJvsVjbPWteUphTK.description:
Requirements Berleth has just used his shovel to Trip a creature

Effect Berleth brutally brings his shovel down on the prone foe, making a shovel Strike. On a hit, the Strike deals damage as normal, plus the target must make a @Check[fortitude|dc:30] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute.

hozDdAMhO9qf2Buo.name: Decapitate
hozDdAMhO9qf2Buo.description:
Berleth plunges his shovel through a creature's neck as though it were peat moss.

He makes a shovel Strike against an adjacent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} creature. On a hit, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Yl48xTdMh3aeQYL2]{Wounded 2} (possibly @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}).

sTXhA6HFH3RVnqjV.name: Final Blow
sTXhA6HFH3RVnqjV.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Berleth is reduced to 0 HP

Effect Berleth makes a final shovel Strike before dying.

BofxZCq1wekuufql.name: Joro Spider Venom
BofxZCq1wekuufql.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:25]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[1d8[poison]] (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[1d8[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[1d8[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} (1 round)

Stage 4 @Damage[2d8[poison]] and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.6uEgoh53GbXuHpTF]{Paralyzed} ([[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds})

vZXFIePI3zP2Og1M.name: Web Trap
vZXFIePI3zP2Og1M.description: A creature hit by the joro spider's web Strike is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and stuck to the nearest surface until it [[/act escape dc=25]]{Escapes}.

Flying Guillotine.name: Flying Guillotine
Flying Guillotine.desc (hazard): An invisible magical glyph on the guillotine's blade detects living creatures in the room, which causes the guillotine to fly off its hinges and attack.
Flying Guillotine.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Erase Glyph|traits:action:disable-a-device] (trained) to erase the glyph (which requires a successful unarmed attack roll if the blade is already active) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 20) to counteract it. The trap has a secret bypass known only to Ralso and Pratchett: as long as the guillotine can see a creature in the room touching thumb and pinky together with an empty hand, it remains dormant.
Flying Guillotine.reset: After 1 minute, the trap deactivates, though the door remains locked. The trap rearms itself each day at dawn.
Flying Guillotine.routine: (1 action) The blade @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Flies} up to 20 feet and Strikes any creatures whose squares it passes through. It cannot target the same creature more than once per round. The blade cannot be grappled and doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.

dDvj6Zila83uSsch.name: Flying Blade
dDvj6Zila83uSsch.description:
Trigger A living creature enters the room

Effect One round after a creature enters the room, the door to the room slams shut and locks (two [[/act pick-a-lock dc=20]]{Thievery} checks to pick), and the guillotine blade detaches from its housing and begins flying around the room as the trap rolls initiative.

hJJc012AkwlepsfP.name: Odorless
hJJc012AkwlepsfP.description: A myrucarx emits no smell and can't be detected by scent.

2JN5a5P81ZqQkOsD.name: Painful Light
