2JN5a5P81ZqQkOsD.description: When attempting a save against a light effect, a myrucarx gets a result one degree of success lower than it rolled. A myrucarx caught in sunlight is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2}.

87HtA52J9Oqfjsft.name: Illusory Persona
87HtA52J9Oqfjsft.description: The illusion created by the myrucarx's project image can resemble any Medium humanoid, including any specific individual it has seen, and has appropriate voice, scent, and mannerisms, allowing the myrucarx to use its Deception check to Impersonate that humanoid if it chooses.

e5D3G73TDu6XWskj.name: Twisting Reach
e5D3G73TDu6XWskj.description:
Frequency once per round

Effect The fanged mouths at the ends of a myrucarx's tendrils twist around obstacles. The myrucarx makes two jaws Strikes against the same target, ignoring the target's cover. Both attacks count toward the myrucarx's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks are made. The myrucarx can't Grab as its next action after Twisting Reach.

Ht4guo51Eky0gFrz.name: Partial Amphibian
Ht4guo51Eky0gFrz.description: The bregdi can breathe air for up to 10 minutes, or up to an hour so long as its skin remains wet.

CBZ2xBopPRbaMVV0.name: Capsize
CBZ2xBopPRbaMVV0.description: The bregdi tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller. It must succeed at an Athletics check with a DC of 35 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the bregdi) or the pilot's Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.

ObuiuOqfP6nhvs9S.name: Tug
ObuiuOqfP6nhvs9S.description:
The bregdi pulls a creature it can reach or a creature holding something it can reach (such as a fishing line in the water).

The bregdi attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:fortitude] check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, it pulls the creature into an adjacent space. On a critical success, the bregdi can also make a jaws Strike against the creature pulled into an adjacent space.

0.label: to Track a creature at half its Hit Points or fewer

26ZZztmP0cFmWp6x.name: Precise Tremorsense 40 feet
26ZZztmP0cFmWp6x.description:
The cobbleswarm's tremorsense is a precise sense out to 40 feet and an imprecise sense out to 80 feet. The cobbleswarm can't sense anything beyond the range of its tremorsense.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Tremorsense]

TBb2TTPl5fRKJQJU.name: Grasping Bites
TBb2TTPl5fRKJQJU.description:
The cobbleswarm attempts an @Check[athletics] check and compares the result to the Fortitude DC of all creatures in its space.

Critical Success The creature falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] damage, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} by the cobbleswarm until the end of the cobbleswarm's next turn.

Success The creature falls prone, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} by the cobbleswarm until the creature until the end of the cobbleswarm's next turn.

S00gbcUTroHxccVJ.name: Pummeling Assault
S00gbcUTroHxccVJ.description: Each enemy in the cobbleswarm's space takes @Damage[2d4[bludgeoning]] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:17|basic] save).

Mr. Snips.name: Mr. Snips
Mr. Snips.description: Traditionally crafted into the forms of giant suits of armor or powerful animals, iron golems are products of exquisite artistry and skill. Their articulated joints and sturdy armored bodies require great care and mathematical precision to craft, and regular cleaning and oiling ensure they don't rust over the ages. With proper care, iron golems can remain in good shape for thousands of years, being passed down for generations, as long as they aren't destroyed by meddlesome adventurers. In addition to their incredible strength, iron golems possess a potent toxic breath weapon that is often more than enough to dispatch entire groups of opponents.

lYvWF5v5Vah9KWsN.name: Golem Antimagic
lYvWF5v5Vah9KWsN.description:
Harmed by acid (@Damage[(6d10+4)[untyped]], @Damage[(2d8+4)[untyped]] from areas and persistent damage); healed by fire (area @Damage[(2d8+4)[healing]] HP); slowed by electricity

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.GolemAntimagic]

aMNM0X0dVvVRdlZT.name: Vulnerable to Neutralize Poison
aMNM0X0dVvVRdlZT.description: Casting @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} on the golem deactivates its Breath Weapon for 1 minute.

SJraLZmz7x1C04ki.name: Vulnerable to Rust
SJraLZmz7x1C04ki.description: Magical rusting effects, like a rust monster's antennae, affect the iron golem normally.

HkUjt1e6CiwdfHoy.name: Breath Weapon
HkUjt1e6CiwdfHoy.description:
The iron golem exhales poisonous gas in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-foot radius} centered on the corner of one of the iron golem's squares.

The gas persists for 1 round. Any creature in the area (or that later enters the area) is exposed to the iron golem's poison.

The golem can't use its Breath Weapon again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breath Weapon]]{1d4 rounds}.

yhVKDXeyQEVchPJW.name: Dismember
yhVKDXeyQEVchPJW.description:
Whenever Mr. Snips rolls a critical hit with a scissors Strike, in addition to dealing extra damage, the golem has a chance to dismember its victim. The target must roll a @Check[reflex|dc:39|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Success No additional effect.

Failure The target takes @Damage[2d10[bleed]].

Critical Failure As failure, and one of the targets extremities is severed (the effects of this are up to the GM's discretion).

nhz5F428cTKGkc9v.name: Inexorable March
nhz5F428cTKGkc9v.description: The iron golem Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a @Check[fortitude|dc:39] save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it is damaged as if hit by the golem's fist.

RSzJjCjwpz8jIS3J.name: Iron Golem Poison
RSzJjCjwpz8jIS3J.description:
Any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained} value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour.

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:35]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[2d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} (1 round)

Stage 3 @Damage[8d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 3} (1 round)

OofTe2WDiLiEdYTm.name: Halfling Luck
OofTe2WDiLiEdYTm.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger The Rabbit Prince fails a skill check or a saving throw

Effect The Rabbit Prince rerolls the triggering check, but he must use the new result, even if it's worse.

CgEMdYYlkqnUPBfB.name: Perfect Will
CgEMdYYlkqnUPBfB.description: If the Rabbit Prince rolls a success on a Will save, he gets a critical success instead, and if he rolls a critical failure, he gets a failure instead.

cg0RVhBfO8MxjPpI.name: Superior Senses
cg0RVhBfO8MxjPpI.description: The Rabbit Prince automatically critically succeeds at Seek actions to find hidden or undetected creatures within 30 feet and at flat checks to target creatures within 30 feet that are concealed or hidden from him.

9KEf9z8ZVsw7qXJg.name: Bloody Jab
9KEf9z8ZVsw7qXJg.description: Whenever the Rabbit Prince deals piercing damage, he also deals 2d10 persistent bleed damage.

s4YFi2Scm3NoZSHU.name: Darting Flurry
s4YFi2Scm3NoZSHU.description: The Rabbit Prince Strides and makes a blade of the Rabbit Prince Strike and a harrow card Strike at any point during the Stride. His multiple attack penalty increases only after both attacks.

2EL49f3yp855RUpq.name: Quick Movements
2EL49f3yp855RUpq.description: The Rabbit Prince doesn't trigger reactions with his movement or with any use of the Thievery skill.

UYn0m6msQksZeSqS.name: Exorcism
UYn0m6msQksZeSqS.description:
Mental damage ignores a siege shard's hardness.

Additionally, proving the siege shard's generative conflict is over with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Ma93dpT4K7JbP9gu]{Prove Peace} activity reverts the creature to ordinary stone.

jcfMZ2vEUL2nEfFQ.name: Surreptitious Siege
jcfMZ2vEUL2nEfFQ.description: While a siege shard is embedded within a structure while using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.vh1RpbWfqdNC4L3P]{One with Stone}, the structure and all objects within it take twice as long to repair.

g67xAp632gfQapHl.name: Overwhelming Anguish
g67xAp632gfQapHl.description:
Frequency once per minute

Effect The siege shard emits a disorienting psychic blast. All creatures within a @Template[emanation|distance:15] take @Damage[4d6[mental]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[will|dc:20|basic|options:area-effect] save).

SoEJRrsphmHa4aoG.name: Rejuvenation
SoEJRrsphmHa4aoG.description:
When a siege shard is destroyed within 100 feet of a structure, it reforms after [[/br 2d4 #days]] days within the nearest structure, fully healed.

A siege shard within a structure can permanently destroyed by the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.adventure-specific-actions.Item.QW2gYIKce3W31xXf]{Prove Peace} activity.

Arcane Feedback Trap.name: Arcane Feedback Trap
Arcane Feedback Trap.desc (hazard): A spike of stone bursts from the south wall and quickly retracts.
Arcane Feedback Trap.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:33|name:Quell Rippling Stone] (master) to quell the rippling stone or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank, counteract DC 31) to dispel the magical feedback.

aSzrKKXR7hl8ZVhX.name: Stone Spike
aSzrKKXR7hl8ZVhX.description:
Trigger A creature in area E1 casts an arcane spell or uses an arcane ability

Effect The trap makes a stone spike attack against the triggering creature. For the next 1 minute thereafter, the ripples are stronger, giving the trap a +2 circumstance bonus on stone spike Strikes during this time.

yX6VKlUamzU5KOQr.name: Bonesense (Imprecise) 30 feet
yX6VKlUamzU5KOQr.description: A giant bone skipper identifies bones and creatures with a skeletal system in the listed range.

Ptf4oQIP2T6623QL.name: Leaping Charge
Ptf4oQIP2T6623QL.description: The giant bone skipper @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leaps} up to 20 feet. It then makes a mandibles Strike, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to its attack roll.

H2cjvx6x95qaiQFo.name: Marrow Rot
H2cjvx6x95qaiQFo.description:
Marrow rot affects only creatures with a skeletal system

Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:25|traits:disease]

Onset 1 day

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} (1 day)

Stage 3 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} (1 day)

Avsheros the Betrayer.name: Avsheros the Betrayer
Avsheros the Betrayer.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

URBxIbTWHH4ZDv0F.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

B8N51wc1bGZzdZ7d.name: Hateful Gaze
B8N51wc1bGZzdZ7d.description:
60 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:45] save. If the creature fails, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure).

Avsheros can deactivate or activate this aura using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

No matter the result of the save, a creature can't be affected by Avsheros's hateful gaze again for 1 minute.

WaEIc7jlHfXb63gH.name: Blasphemous Arms
WaEIc7jlHfXb63gH.description: Any weapon gains the effects of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.gmMrJREf4JSHd2dZ]{Unholy} property rune while Avsheros wields it.

AkqOlXLB6K0JLoqz.name: Wail of the Betrayed
AkqOlXLB6K0JLoqz.description:
Avsheros lets out an agonized wail that invokes grief and a feeling of betrayal in those who hear it.

All creatures within 120 feet must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:47] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. A creature frightened in this way can't willingly accept aid of any kind from an ally until the frightened condition is removed.

On a successful save, the creature is immune to Avsheros's Wail of the Betrayed for 24 hours.

Dreadsong Dancer.name: Dreadsong Dancer
Dreadsong Dancer.saves: +2 status to all saves vs. composition spells

cNdgAyzrxvT3Z68j.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Composition Spells

4QRkjb5aTrVTZYRO.name: Jealous Musician
4QRkjb5aTrVTZYRO.description:
Trigger A creature plays an instrument while Casting a Spell or casts a composition spell within 20 feet of the dreadsong dancer

Effect The dreadsong dancer Strides up to 20 feet and makes a songblade Strike against the triggering creature. If the Strike hits, the spell is disrupted.

oaYvNv83OSKkOI6V.name: Performance Anxiety
oaYvNv83OSKkOI6V.description:
A dreadsong dancer is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} if they see or hear a creature critically succeed at a Performance check or at a saving throw against their Dreadsong.

The dreadsong dancer is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened 1} for 1 round if they see or hear a creature critically fail at a Performance check or a saving throw against their Dreadsong.

They can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.

8K2BcPcACmOHHydT.name: Dreadsong
8K2BcPcACmOHHydT.description:
The dreadsong dancer whirls their howling songblades and cloaks themself in illusion magic. Each non-fiend creature in a @Template[emanation|distance:30] from the dreadsong dancer must attempt a @Check[will|dc:29] save.

Critical Success No effect, and the creature is temporarily immune for 24 hours. The dreadsong dancer is affected by their performance anxiety.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}, and the dreadsong dancer is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} by the creature for 1 minute. The creature can't use Seek to find the dreadsong dancer.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature can't reduce its frightened condition below 2 for 1 minute. In addition, the dreadsong dancer is affected by its performance anxiety.

ePXkUAkuSGauQ7Jv.name: Supersonic Hearing

eJY1bfWIhxuD4h0H.name: Delay Condition
eJY1bfWIhxuD4h0H.description: The binumir's dual spirit takes longer to be affected by detrimental effects. When the binumir is the target of an effect that imparts the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned} condition, the condition is automatically suppressed until the end of the binumir's next turn.

Zc0ocF6ln2ziU1iE.name: Agonizing Wail
Zc0ocF6ln2ziU1iE.description:
The binumir unleashes a distressing cry that fills others with wrenching sadness. Creatures within 30 feet must attempt a @Check[will|dc:17] save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Agonizing Wail for 1 minute.

Success The target can't use reactions for 1 round.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} and can't use reactions for 1 minute as it sobs uncontrollably. It can attempt a new Will save to end the effect at the end of each of its turns.

Critical Failure As failure, but the target can't make saves to end the effect.

wAYzRxbZPCt548k7.name: Dual Assault
wAYzRxbZPCt548k7.description:
The binumir makes four Strikes; no more than two can be against the same target.

These attacks count toward the binumir's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks have been made.

Inky Tendrils.name: Inky Tendrils
Inky Tendrils.desc (hazard): Six giant tentacles reach up from the ink lake, grabbing any foes in reach and dragging them underwater.
Inky Tendrils.disable:
@Check[athletics|dc:48|name:Disable Athletics] (legendary) or @Check[acrobatics|dc:45|name:Disable Acrobatics] (master) to tie one tentacle into a knot, rendering it useless, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (8th rank; counteract DC 44) to counteract one tentacle.

The death of the Daemonic Rumormonger permanently dispels all the inky tendrils.
Inky Tendrils.routine: (6 actions) The hazard loses 1 action for every tentacle that is disabled or destroyed. The tentacles can combine their actions to use the hazard's Inky Imitator ability. A broken tentacle can still Strike, but it can't Grab. This hazard takes no multiple attack penalty.

4nJSWcGlNE3k6uH0.name: Black Ink Delirium
4nJSWcGlNE3k6uH0.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 @Damage[3d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} (1 round)

Stage 2 @Damage[6d6[poison]] damage and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yblD8fOR1J8rDwEQ]{Confused} (1 round)

Dz4rpuIMNqJy4V90.name: Inky Imitator
Dz4rpuIMNqJy4V90.description:
The inky tendrils cast a 10th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.73rToy0v5Ra9NvL6]{Duplicate Foe} spell (@Check[fortitude|dc:40|name:Duplicate Foe]) on the target; on a failed save, a simulacrum of the target made from dripping ink and clockwork scraps emerges from any other spot (tendrils' choice) in the lake.

The tendrils don't need to Sustain the Spell; the duplicate exists for 1 minute or until it is destroyed before collapsing into a puddle of ink and scrap metal.

b9gVzcE3UM4ixbBV.name: Tendrils Come Alive
b9gVzcE3UM4ixbBV.description:
Trigger A non-daemonic creature moves within 15 feet of the shoreline

Effect The hazard makes a tentacle Strike against the triggering creature and the hazard rolls initiative.

Jonis Flakfatter.name: Jonis Flakfatter
Jonis Flakfatter.saves: +2 status to all saves vs. disease and poison

7nwDQbdYpJ5U6EZs.name: Call Toxins
7nwDQbdYpJ5U6EZs.description: 30 feet. Flakfatter exudes an aura that makes poisons more potent. His melee Strikes deal an additional @Damage[2d8[persistent,poison]]. Creatures in the aura attempting a flat check to remove persistent poison damage must roll twice and take the lower result. Flakfatter can suppress or resume this aura as a free action.

Ikix1zKqDpYhzRYA.name: Infector
Ikix1zKqDpYhzRYA.description: Flakfatter targets a creature within 30 feet that's currently subject to a poison affliction. The poison affliction progresses to the next stage.

fkyMMwCkFLHVH5BV.name: Steady Spellcasting
fkyMMwCkFLHVH5BV.description: If a reaction would disrupt Flakfatter's spellcasting action, he attempts a @Check[flat|dc:15] check. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.

of0eB3PZMwreV0L4.name: Furious Pacifier
of0eB3PZMwreV0L4.description: Lavarsus adds double his Strength modifier to any nonlethal melee Strikes he makes with a bludgeoning weapon.

GTs7sVH9yhH8mKkM.name: Nonlethal Training
GTs7sVH9yhH8mKkM.description:
Lavarsus has trained to take down suspects without killing them.

He can choose to make nonlethal attacks with any bludgeoning weapon without taking the usual penalty to his attack roll.

Gas Trap.name: Gas Trap
Gas Trap.desc (hazard): A spring slams and locks the room's door before four hidden gas vents begin pumping poison gas into the chamber.
Gas Trap.disable: Four @Check[thievery|dc:20|name:Block Gas Vents|traits:action:disable-a-device] checks to block the gas vents, or a @Check[thievery|dc:26|name:Unlock Door|traits:action:pick-a-lock] check to unlock the door and escape
Gas Trap.reset: The trap must be manually rearmed by unblocking the vents or replacing the poison gas tank in area E30.
Gas Trap.routine:
(1 action) Each round on its initiative count, the trap pumps more toxic gas into the room.

Any breathing creature in the room takes @Damage[4d6[poison]] damage (a successful @Check[fortitude|dc:22|traits:poison,damaging-effect] save halves the damage taken). If a creature acts before the trap on the first round, it has the option of holding its breath to postpone taking damage from the trap-holding one's breath after the trap's first action has no effect, since the air in the creature's lungs is already tainted. Locating and blocking one of the hidden gas vents reduces the poison damage by 1d6-if all four are blocked, the trap is disabled, though the door remains locked. Otherwise, the trap functions for 1 minute before all the gas is expended and characters in the room cease taking damage, after which the trap ventilates the room for 1 additional minute.
Gas Trap.stealth: (trained) to smell the poison gas or hear it hissing

chuMKB6cHYONy4NC.name: Toxic Gas
chuMKB6cHYONy4NC.description:
Trigger A creature opens one of the drawers

Effect The door to the room slams shut and locks and the trap rolls initiative. (The trap can also be triggered manually or disarmed from area E30.)

k1KchqR9i8uSyT6e.name: Combustible
k1KchqR9i8uSyT6e.description: The first time each round that the Daemonic Infector takes fire damage, his fumes combust, dealing @Damage[30[fire]] damage to all other creatures within the area of his toxic fumes aura.

zchaebxlIBynZinm.name: Toxic Fumes
zchaebxlIBynZinm.description:
10 feet. A creature that enters or begins its turn within the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:44] save.

On a failed save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1}, and on a critical failure, it's also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 1 minute. In addition, creatures within the aura attempting a flat check to remove @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Poison Damage} must roll twice and take the lower result.

uXNPc5LpmbvMlOa5.name: Breathe Death
uXNPc5LpmbvMlOa5.description:
The Daemonic Infector exhales a @Template[line|distance:30] of concentrated fumes.

Each creature in the area takes @Damage[12d10[poison]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:44|basic|options:area-effect,inflicts:drained] save; on a critical failure the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}).

The Infector can't Breathe Death again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Breathe Death]]{1d4 rounds}.

Ez5LQ3xID56lShet.name: Infector
Ez5LQ3xID56lShet.description: The Daemonic targets a creature within 30 feet that's currently subject to a poison affliction. The poison affliction progresses to the next stage.

CU5CXS5c5trwAd9g.name: Steady Spellcasting
CU5CXS5c5trwAd9g.description: If a reaction would disrupt the Daemonic Infector's spellcasting action, he attempts a @Check[flat|dc:15] check. On a success, the action isn't disrupted.

WeIVzFTJRVOOXc8w.name: Magic Susceptibility
WeIVzFTJRVOOXc8w.description:
An almiraj takes a -2 status penalty to saving throws against occult spells.

Any beneficial occult spells with a duration of 1 round or longer cast on the almiraj last twice as long.

oIOsV3m1VCQehtGp.name: Magic Horn
oIOsV3m1VCQehtGp.description:
Any living creature slain by the almiraj's horn Strike immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} with no saving throw, in addition to dying.

A severed almiraj horn retains a wisp of its former magic; in combat, the horn can be wielded as a +1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.rQWaJhI5Bko5x14Z]{Dagger} or, if affixed to a shaft, a +1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.tOhoGvmCMw4JpWcS]{Spear}

Clockwork Poison Bomb.name: Clockwork Poison Bomb
Clockwork Poison Bomb.hpdetails: to ruin the nozzle (making it impossible to disable, in which case the only way to disarm the bomb is to destroy both its tanks); Tank Hardness 15; Tank HP 80 (BT 40) to destroy one of the tanks (both tanks must be destroyed to disarm the bomb
Clockwork Poison Bomb.desc (hazard): A clockwork bomb releases gouts of poisonous smoke. The smoke issues forth from a single nozzle attached to two tanks of pressurized poison
Clockwork Poison Bomb.disable: Three [[/act disable-device dc=31]]{DC 31 Thievery} (expert) checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device} to disable the latches that lock the nozzle in place, then one [[/act disable-device dc=35]]{DC 35 Thievery} (master) check to Disable a Device to turn off the nozzle; DCs decrease by 2 if Oggvurm is immobilized, paralyzed, unconscious, or dead
Clockwork Poison Bomb.reset: The trap issues smoke for 3 minutes before its tanks run dry. The tanks must be replaced before the bomb can be reactivated.
Clockwork Poison Bomb.routine: (1 action) On its turn, the bomb spews forth a smoky gout of airborne @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WvDbdESFJY6Be2u1]{Blackfinger Blight} poison. The cloud fills a 20-foot radius, or a 10-foot radius if only one tank remains intact. If the bomb is already in the center of a blackfinger blight cloud, the radius of that cloud increases by 20 feet (or 10 feet, if only one tank remains intact) instead.
Clockwork Poison Bomb.stealth: The bomb uses Oggvurm's initiative roll as its Stealth roll

FH3nsGdSWs8rbUYr.name: Poisonous Cloud
FH3nsGdSWs8rbUYr.description:
Trigger The bomb is Activated, which requires 3 actions

Effect The bomb releases a smoky cloud of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.WvDbdESFJY6Be2u1]{Blackfinger Blight} in a 20-foot radius. Creatures within the smoke are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} from other creatures.

Any creature that starts its turn in the smoke must roll a @Check[fortitude|dc:32|name:Blackfinger Blight|traits:contact,virulent] saving throw to avoid being afflicted by blackfinger blight poison.

The cloud remains for 1 minute or until dispersed by strong winds.

JQLaH8N9rTPhEzqj.name: Sword Cane Duelist
JQLaH8N9rTPhEzqj.description: Each round, Pratchett can Strike once with each component of a sword cane without incurring the usual multiple attack penalty. Subsequent attacks incur the multiple attack penalty as usual.

Waxworks Onslaught Trap.name: Waxworks Onslaught Trap
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.hpdetails: to destroy a tub and prevent it from making any further attacks; Door Seal Hardness 18; Door Seal HP 72 (BT 36) to destroy the wax on a sealed door and allow anyone to escape through the door
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.desc (hazard): Four huge tubs containing congealed wax, enchanted to melt and envelop unwary intruders, each sit atop a cold fire.
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:43|name:Drain Wax from a Tub|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) to drain the wax from a tub or @Check[athletics|dc:45|name:Push Through Wax|traits:action:force-open] (master) to push through the wax blocking a sealed door and escape (other creatures must push their own way through, as the wax reseals)
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 hour. At that time, the wax in the tubs cools and congeals, and any wax elsewhere in the room magically goes back into the tubs.
Waxworks Onslaught Trap.routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn per drained or destroyed tub. On each action, a different tub spews hot wax at a random creature in the room, dealing @Damage[3d12[fire]|options:area-damage] damage to the target and all adjacent creatures (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic|options:area-effect] save). On a failure or critical failure, the creature is also encased in hot wax. A creature that starts its turn encased in wax takes @Damage[8d12[fire]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} until it [[/act escape dc=35]]{Escapes} the hardening wax. Each turn it remains encased, the damage dealt by the hot wax decreases by 2d12 but the DC to Escape increases by 2 (minimum 0 damage, maximum DC 43). A creature that can't get free from the wax might suffocate.

aSPT9O0IpzqjiqG0.name: Seal Room
aSPT9O0IpzqjiqG0.description:
Trigger A creature comes within 5 feet of a tub

Effect The fires beneath the vats blaze to life, magically melting the wax in the tubs. The tubs emit gouts of wax over the room's exits, sealing them shut. The trap then rolls initiative.

Freezing Alarm.name: Freezing Alarm
Freezing Alarm.desc (hazard): Miniature snowflake-shaped glyphs on the ground cause a layer of ice to ripple over the floor of the room and sound a silent alarm.
Freezing Alarm.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:53|name:Disable Arcana] (legendary) to draw a fiery counteracting glyph over each snowflake, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank, counteract DC 48)

DdFilDnuHDObT81V.name: Freeze Floor
DdFilDnuHDObT81V.description:
Trigger A creature enters one of the three squares marked with a T on the map

Effect The floor of the entire 10-foot-by-15-foot antechamber freezes over, sending deadly magical frost creeping up the legs of the intruders. Any creatures standing in the room must roll a @Check[reflex|dc:45] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes @Damage[(3d10+5)[cold]] damage.

Failure The creature takes @Damage[(6d10+10)[cold]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

Critical Failure The creature takes @Damage[(12d10+20)[cold]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 minute.

Additionally, the golems in area B10 become aware of the intruders. The golems activate and come to this room to attack, if they haven't been destroyed already.

Rhevanna.name: Rhevanna
Rhevanna.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

bfY8oZGxT5bdbToz.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

II1iKHEPt0qdurXn.name: Plunder Life
II1iKHEPt0qdurXn.description:
60 feet. When a healing effect restores Hit Points to a non-fiend creature in the aura, the amount of Hit Points restored is halved. The rhevanna gains temporary Hit Points equal to the amount of Hit Points restored.

The rhevanna loses any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

JnTr0G2JvwVYzdfR.name: Detaining Strike
JnTr0G2JvwVYzdfR.description:
Frequency once per round

Trigger The rhevanna hits a creature with a weapon Strike

Effect The rhevanna casts an innate @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.ksLCg62cLOojw3gN]{Planar Tether} spell on the creature.

SMwhRQyOrogJbUal.name: Lifedrinker
SMwhRQyOrogJbUal.description:
Trigger The rhevanna kills a living creature of at least 16th level

Effect The rhevanna drinks the triggering creature's life force and regains @Damage[40[healing]] Hit Points. If the triggering creature is a celestial, the rhevanna instead regains @Damage[80[healing]] Hit Points.

1cQlKfzWAd8gXGFa.name: Malefic Binding
1cQlKfzWAd8gXGFa.description:
The rhevanna can target celestials with their @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.GYmXvS9NJ7QwfWGg]{Seize Soul} ability, and a gem containing a celestial bound by a rhevanna has Hardness 40.

If the rhevanna destroys a gem in which they placed a celestial, the celestial is destroyed forever.

The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.name: The Laughing Fiend's Greeting
The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.desc (hazard): Subtle but deadly magical runes link this mural to Kharnas's master. Good- or neutral-aligned creatures who examine the mural witness the castle's drawbridge silently descend, revealing an endless darkness.
The Laughing Fiend's Greeting.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:44|name:Disable Thievery] (legendary) to obscure or mar the magical runes set into the mural, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (9th rank; counteract DC 42) to counteract the mural

OMtflrg7VM1ogHqZ.name: Tegresin's Greeting
OMtflrg7VM1ogHqZ.description:
Trigger A creature capable of casting divine magic examines the mural

Effect The mural casts @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.qDjeG6dxT4aEEC6J]{Weird} (@Check[will|dc:43|traits:death,emotion,fear,illusion,mental,damaging-effect] save) on all creatures in the gallery. A snarl fills the creatures' minds.

Canopy Drop.name: Canopy Drop
Canopy Drop.desc (hazard): A trapdoor, connected to floor sensors, opens in the section of floor marked on the map, while the surrounding floor suddenly tilts to a 45-degree angle and the fountains in the wall begin spraying at high pressure, making the tile slippery and pushing creatures toward the open chute.
Canopy Drop.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:23|name:Jam Trapdoor Mechanism|traits:action:disable-a-device] (expert) to jam the mechanisms and keep the trapdoor from opening, or to locate the bypass switch hidden under a stair riser just outside the room

MClpWaT5c8jTmcFK.name: Flush
MClpWaT5c8jTmcFK.description:
Trigger Two or more creatures stand on the trapped spaces

Effect One round after the trap is triggered, all creatures in the room fall 40 feet down the shaft to area E36, taking @Damage[20[bludgeoning]|options:fall-damage] damage from the fall plus @Damage[2d6[piercing]] damage as they land in the spiked pit.

The creatures can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.3yoajuKjwHZ9ApUY]{Grab an Edge} to snag the hammock or one of the hanging storage containers to avoid falling.

The DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.pprgrYQ1QnIDGZiy]{Climb} the walls or Grab an Edge is 20.

kfZVz80JupwQ5DE1.name: Bloody Chain Aura
kfZVz80JupwQ5DE1.description:
20 feet. Chains of blood bind a bleeding creature to the Daemonic Skinner.

Creatures in range that are taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Bleed Damage} can't move out of the aura.

The Skinner can have only one aura active at a time.

She can switch her active aura as an Interact action.

cdoPISuZdSbxOwT1.name: Spell Choke
cdoPISuZdSbxOwT1.description:
Trigger A creature taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Bleed Damage} within 30 feet of the Daemonic Skinner Casts a Spell with a verbal component or speaks

Effect The Skinner wills the triggering creature's blood to gush from their mouth and constrict their throat. The target's spell is disrupted.

The target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:47] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

rJu8a6w24iFChezA.name: Transfusion Aura
rJu8a6w24iFChezA.description:
30 feet. Any time a creature in the aura takes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Bleed Damage}, the Daemonic Skinner regains the same number of Hit Points as the damage dealt.

The Skinner can have only one aura active at a time.

She can switch her active aura as an Interact action.

1h5CBWyXY0MAHGtm.name: Bloody Sneak Attack
1h5CBWyXY0MAHGtm.description: Any creature taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Bleed Damage} is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the Daemonic Skinner's attacks. When attacking an off-guard creature, the Skinner deals an additional 2d6 precision damage.

IEuErW2Q6KaGlk21.name: Hook and Flay
IEuErW2Q6KaGlk21.description:
Requirements The Daemonic Skinner has a creature grabbed with her blood chain or a creature is affected by her bloody chain aura

Effect The Skinner pulls the creature into the nearest open adjacent square and makes a cleaver Strike against the creature.

3aasDsiXoE4xtSVZ.name: Distracting Shadows
3aasDsiXoE4xtSVZ.description: Skebs can use creatures that are at least one size larger than themself as cover for the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} actions.

ZEbYuhDFGc3fADE1.name: Sneak Attack
ZEbYuhDFGc3fADE1.description: Skebs deals 1d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

Water Elemental Vessel.name: Water Elemental Vessel
Water Elemental Vessel.description: Spellcasters create elemental vessels by harvesting raw elemental energy and then binding it within a specially enchanted magic circle to grant it life.

N85UwJsuAe8nwuWV.name: Spell Circle
N85UwJsuAe8nwuWV.description: By performing an hour-long ritual, an elemental vessel can form a spell circle with an arcane or primal spellcaster. After the spell circle is formed, other spellcasters can join the spell circle by performing the same hour-long ritual while assisted by at least one spellcaster already in the spell circle. Each member of the spell circle must contribute at least one spell to the elemental vessel. The spellcaster permanently loses access to a spell slot equal to the spell's rank and the elemental vessel adds the contributed spell to its list of arcane innate spells (regardless of the spell's original type). An elemental vessel can be imbued with no more than three spells per spell rank. If the elemental vessel is destroyed, all members of the spell circle regain the spell slots they contributed to the creature. The arcane innate spells shown below represent a typical spell list for an elemental vessel, but each elemental vessel is likely to have different spells depending on what its spell circle has contributed.

fgprZ9vs1zfRUz3o.name: Dispel Vulnerability
fgprZ9vs1zfRUz3o.description: Whenever a creature successfully counteracts one of its spells, the vessel permanently loses access to that spell and takes damage equal to 4 × the spell's rank. The spell circle member who contributed that spell regains access to their contributed spell slot.

jJSKOhaRoCp1WwP4.name: Inhabit Vessel
jJSKOhaRoCp1WwP4.description: Any member of the elemental vessel's spell circle can spend 3 actions to mentally inhabit the vessel for 1 round. While they inhabit the vessel, the inhabiter controls the vessel's actions, and the vessel uses the inhabiter's Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma modifiers for all checks. Only one creature can inhabit an elemental vessel at a time.

6pCE969IqFRVqLzJ.name: Engulf
6pCE969IqFRVqLzJ.description:
@Check[reflex|dc:35] save, no damage, [[/act escape dc=35]], Rupture 28

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

g8bRqHNpfEqsTYyx.name: Internal Spell Strike
g8bRqHNpfEqsTYyx.description: The elemental vessel targets an engulfed creature with one of its spells. The spell must have a range of touch.

Lusca.name: Lusca
Lusca.description: A lusca is a predatory sea monster that resembles a three-headed shark with the body of an octopus. Ferocious electrical storms usually herald a lusca's arrival; such violent bursts of electricity result from the creature's superconductive flesh, which allows the lusca to store energy from lightning strikes that it can then discharge at foes.

DSVJsEHiWFPACcNX.name: Attack of Opportunity
DSVJsEHiWFPACcNX.description:
The lusca gains 2 extra reactions at the start of each of its turns that it can use only to make an Attack of Opportunity with its jaws. It can't use more than one Attack of Opportunity triggered by the same action.

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

RkUX9VYzuGsIycUb.name: Blood Scent
RkUX9VYzuGsIycUb.description: The lusca can smell blood in the water up to 1 mile away.

uW2CbK6jDKtg1sG4.name: Storm Bringer
uW2CbK6jDKtg1sG4.description: When the lusca is near the surface for more than 1 hour, clouds appear and deliver a thunderstorm with a 2-mile radius centered on its location. The weather returns to normal 1 hour after the lusca departs.

hDbNl3kiEPn8AUos.name: Capsize
hDbNl3kiEPn8AUos.description: The lusca tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller. It must succeed at an Athletics check with a DC of 35 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the lusca) or the pilot's Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.

VzGeaeMNgzVgxvGo.name: Lusca Venom
VzGeaeMNgzVgxvGo.description:
Saving Throw @Check[fortitude|dc:38]

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 poison damage and clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 6d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round)

f9SGRyWKHiuofcI9.name: Ravenous Jaws
f9SGRyWKHiuofcI9.description: The lusca makes three jaws Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count toward the lusca's multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after the lusca makes all of these attacks. If the lusca subsequently uses the Grab action, it Grabs any number of creatures it hit with Ravenous Jaws.

UylfhYpRBAz42DrH.name: Flurry of Blows
UylfhYpRBAz42DrH.description:
Shristi makes two unarmed Strikes. If both hit the same creature, combine their damage for the purposes of resistances and weaknesses. He applies his multiple attack penalty to the Strikes normally.

As it has the flourish trait, Shristi can use Flurry of Blows only once per turn.

7PJ0xQKU3T5EtaPW.name: Heaven's Thunder
7PJ0xQKU3T5EtaPW.description:
Frequency twice per day

Effect With a loud shout, Shristi unleashes his ki as a crackling shroud of thunder and lightning that engulfs his body. Until the end of his next turn, Shristi's unarmed Strikes and Strikes with weapons that have the monk trait deal an additional 3 electricity damage and 3 sonic damage.

1a9J9jdVUsp4RIxQ.name: Sky and Heaven Stance
1a9J9jdVUsp4RIxQ.description:
Shristi enters a combat stance perfected by past champions of the Challenge of Sky and Heaven. While in this stance, the only Strikes Shristi can make are skyward slash unarmed attacks. These deal 1d10 slashing damage; are in the brawling group; and have the nonlethal, unarmed, and versatile P traits.

While in Sky and Heaven Stance, Shristi gains resistance 2 to electricity and sonic damage.

Pelmo.name: Pelmo
Pelmo.description:
The frontline fighters of goblin tribes prefer to fight in large groups-especially when they can outnumber their foes at least three to one.

These small humanoids have green or gray skin and large heads with wide ears. While some goblins are civilized and have worked hard to be considered upstanding members of humanoid communities, most are impetuous and vicious creatures who delight in wreaking havoc. These goblins think nothing of slaughtering livestock, stealing infants, or burning down a building purely for momentary delight. They revel in playing malicious tricks on taller humanoids, whom they call "longshanks."

Goblins are superstitious, with an intense awe of magic and a fascination with fire; goblins who master magic or fire earn great respect from their kin. Most other humanoids find it difficult to understand goblins' outlook: they hate canines but eagerly share their lairs with so-called "goblin dogs," they fearlessly attack larger creatures but are terrified of horses, and they despise vegetables yet consider pickles a delicacy. To a goblin, of course, these are all perfectly sensible life choices.

32FbUxGNpWinXjEq.name: Goblin Scuttle
32FbUxGNpWinXjEq.description:
Trigger A goblin ally ends a move action adjacent to Pelmo.

Effect Pelmo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.UHpkTuCtyaPqiCAB]{Steps}.

5hCSuILSsdP2wKtN.name: Cheek Pouches
5hCSuILSsdP2wKtN.description: A ratfolk has stretchy cheek pouches that can store up to 1 cubic foot of objects. The ratfolk can remove or store an item using the Interact action. As long as the ratfolk has at least one object in its cheek pouches, its speech is noticeably difficult to understand.

hrbhUgMW0KZvWovb.name: Katar Specialist
hrbhUgMW0KZvWovb.description: Gref has trained extensively with the katar blade. Any katar he wields gains the finesse trait.

viGvtlLGXHhsAVh8.name: Quick Stow
viGvtlLGXHhsAVh8.description:
Frequency once per round.

Effect Gref stores one held item of light or negligible Bulk in his cheek pouches.

mjEOGwxDnDNV6VB0.name: Swarming
mjEOGwxDnDNV6VB0.description:
A ratfolk can end its movement in the same square as an ally that also has this ability.

Only two such creatures can share the same space.

933yJ4bfZhr9zTIX.name: Collapse
933yJ4bfZhr9zTIX.description:
Trigger The Iroran skeleton is critically hit

Effect The Iroran skeleton collapses into a pile of bones and the attack deals damage for a hit, rather than a critical hit.

The skeleton can reform in a standing position as an action, but until it does, it is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard}.

shJIHzhh4j6cG3tv.name: Flurry of Claws
shJIHzhh4j6cG3tv.description:
The Iroran skeleton makes two claw Strikes. If both hit the same creature, the damage is combined for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses.

The multiple attack penalty applies to the Strikes as normal.

ZBfbG1IkIDHWmhM2.name: Wall Run
ZBfbG1IkIDHWmhM2.description: The Iroran skeleton can Stride along vertical surfaces, such as walls, as long as it begins and ends its movement on a horizontal surface.

GutcPWbxQjMoihFA.name: Water Step
GutcPWbxQjMoihFA.description: The Iroran skeleton can Stride across liquid surfaces. If it ends its movement on a liquid surface, it falls in as normal.

sVBakTcoJU3kPGlY.name: Whirlwind Kick
sVBakTcoJU3kPGlY.description: The Iroran skeleton makes a single Strike and compares the result to the AC of all creatures within its reach, dealing damage to each creature hit.

WWLbZOyOAUEoJrVO.name: Fast Swallow
WWLbZOyOAUEoJrVO.description:
Trigger The minchgorm Grabs a creature in its jaws

Effect The minchgorm uses Swallow Whole.

kVdw249CmzAbj17U.name: Riptide
kVdw249CmzAbj17U.description: Tentacles of water rise up and attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple} all enemies within 15 feet of the minchgorm. The minchgorm attempts an @Check[athletics] check against the Fortitude DC of each creature in the area. On a success, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} ([[/act escape dc=40]]). On a critical success, or a success against a creature that is already grabbed, the target begins to drown.

SczLJpfQwYYTKEvD.name: Watery Simulacra
SczLJpfQwYYTKEvD.description: The minchgorm raises up to eight figures from nearby water, each appearing in an empty space within 60 feet of the minchgorm. A simulacrum can take any shape of size Medium or smaller that the minchgorm desires, including that of a specific individual or object, but is always plainly made of water. The minchgorm can speak, cast spells, and use its senses through its simulacra, spending actions for a simulacrum on a one-for-one basis. By using a single action with the concentrate trait, the minchgorm can cause any number of simulacra to Fly, Step, Stride, or Swim up to 60 feet. A simulacrum uses the minchgorm's AC and saving throws and has 30 Hit Points. A minchgorm can have up to eight simulacra in existence at once. Simulacra dissolve immediately when more than 60 feet from the minchgorm, or if the minchgorm dies or falls unconscious. The minchgorm can dismiss any number of its simulacra as a free action.

wuytt71AuRJcaryt.name: Sidestep
wuytt71AuRJcaryt.description:
Trigger The attack roll for a Strike targeting the assassin fails or critically fails

Effect The assassin deftly steps out of the way of the attack. If there's another creature adjacent to the assassin and within reach of the triggering attack, the assassin redirects the attack to that adjacent creature. The attacker then rerolls the Strike's attack roll against the new target.

o1pfLDPNAQy8FT0p.name: Point Blank
o1pfLDPNAQy8FT0p.description: The master assassin makes a crossbow Strike against an adjacent enemy; unlike most ranged Strikes, this Strike doesn't provoke reactions. If successful, the attack deals an additional 4d8 precision damage.

SMg5BMoXiwN9nxmJ.name: Running Reload
SMg5BMoXiwN9nxmJ.description: The master assassin Strides, Steps, or Sneaks, then Interacts to reload her crossbow.

MjTG6JP6vMA8bV3d.name: Sneak Attack
MjTG6JP6vMA8bV3d.description: The master assassin deals an additional 3d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

mRPwn3ixbA1j5Wfz.name: Study Target
mRPwn3ixbA1j5Wfz.description: The master assassin observes a single target she can see, allowing her to use her Vorpal Garrote during the next round.

uIpZm7bCNAs8c7BV.name: Vorpal Garrote
uIpZm7bCNAs8c7BV.description:
Requirements The master assassin used Study Target during the previous round and must have a garrote bolt

Effect The master assassin makes a crossbow Strike against the target she previously studied. If she rolls a success on her attack roll, she gets a critical success instead. The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:36|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Success No additional effect.

Failure The target takes an additional 3d12 precision damage.

Critical Failure The target is decapitated and instantly dies unless it doesn't require a head to live.

TFvB8Q4vaggsZeH2.name: Infused Items
TFvB8Q4vaggsZeH2.description: Japu carries the following infused items, which last 24 hours or until the next time he makes his daily preparations: infused moderate acid flasks (2), infused moderate alchemist's fires (2), moderate elixirs of life (2), infused reagents (6), infused moderate tanglefoot bags (2).

DREnRy1SAHY6dCiU.name: Alchemical Formulas (10th)
DREnRy1SAHY6dCiU.description: moderate acid flask, moderate alchemist's fire, greater antidote, moderate bravo's brew, moderate elixir of life, moderate tanglefoot bag, wyvern poison

PigzABnoSkZuUAGP.name: Expanded Splash
PigzABnoSkZuUAGP.description: Japu's bombs that have the splash trait deal 5 splash damage and splash to 10 feet.

iFX6Z8UsTWukjUxp.name: Quick Alchemy
iFX6Z8UsTWukjUxp.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents

Effect Japu creates a single alchemical item from his formula book (see Alchemical Formulas). This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the end of his next turn.

loHKBZQtnioHzbFm.name: Quick Bomber
loHKBZQtnioHzbFm.description: Japu Interacts to draw a bomb then Strikes with it.

Ulressia The Blessed.name: Ulressia The Blessed
Ulressia The Blessed.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

JCwAfoQqJDmPTVLF.name: Crystal Sense (Imprecise) 30 feet
JCwAfoQqJDmPTVLF.description: Ulressia automatically detects crystals or crystalline items within 30 feet.

b2SP5cdUj5x7kBVf.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

E9Cr9P2L3cp3NzRD.name: Aura of Angry Crystals
E9Cr9P2L3cp3NzRD.description:
60 feet. Any creature that ends its turn in the aura while in possession of any crystals, gemstones, or other precious stones must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:39|traits:damaging-effect] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is immune to the aura for 1 hour.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature's crystals reverberate with Ulressia's vengeful aura, sharpening at every corner and digging, as if powerfully magnetized, into the creature's flesh.

The creature takes @Damage[4d6[piercing]] damage, plus @Damage[5[void]] damage for every 2,000 gp the crystals are cumulatively worth (maximum 40 damage).

The creature can't discard the crystals until they leave the aura or roll a successful save against it.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[8d6[piercing]] damage, plus @Damage[10[void]] damage for every 2,000 gp of the crystals' value (maximum 80 damage).

Ulressia can deactivate or activate this aura using a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

ukjOJLhlz5hOZcuy.name: Crystallize Blood
ukjOJLhlz5hOZcuy.description:
Ulressia channels her warped powers over crystals through her blade and into a creature's body, partially crystallizing its blood.

Ulressia makes a melee dagger Strike. On a hit, the creature takes damage as normal and must also roll a @Check[fortitude|dc:41] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1}, plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 2}, plus @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for [[/gmr 1d4 #rounds]]{1d4 rounds}.

5B9QSKBjBa9tC0SG.name: Stunning Strike
5B9QSKBjBa9tC0SG.description:
Requirements Ulressia hit a foe earlier this turn with a weapon Strike

Effect Ulressia makes a weapon Strike against the foe. On a success, the foe must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:41] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. On a critical failure, the foe is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 2} instead.

Overdrive Imentesh.name: Overdrive Imentesh
Overdrive Imentesh.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

zn2a2GvxqbknqXbo.name: Entropy Sense (Imprecise) 60 feet
zn2a2GvxqbknqXbo.description:
An overdrive imentesh can anticipate the most likely location of a creature through their supernatural insight into the forces of chaotic probabilities and chance. This grants the overdrive imentesh the ability to sense creatures within the listed range.

The overdrive imentesh's entropy sense doesn't detect creatures under the effects of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.EoKBlgf6Smt8opaU]{Veil of Privacy} or that are otherwise shielded from divinations and predictions.

MjoBNCbeXJ2pGmEW.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

I23rYMszuvKL97k7.name: Protean Anatomy 19
I23rYMszuvKL97k7.description:
A overdrive imentesh's vital organs shift and change shape and position constantly.

Immediately after the hegessik takes acid, electricity, or sonic damage, it gains the listed amount of resistance to that damage type. This lasts for 1 hour or until the next time the protean takes damage of one of the other types (in which case its resistance changes to match that type), whichever comes first.

The overdrive imentesh is immune to polymorph effects unless it is a willing target. If @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened}, the overdrive imentesh automatically recovers at the end of its next turn as new sensory organs grow to replace the compromised ones.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.c6SiBB3mzV8lZUQr]{Effect: Protean Anatomy}

TmEWLqRkXgHmnIV4.name: Change Shape
TmEWLqRkXgHmnIV4.description:
The imentesh takes the appearance of any Large or smaller creature. This doesn't change its Speed or its attack and damage bonuses with its Strikes, but it might change the damage type its Strikes deal.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

O97E3bY0dRr5pLCH.name: Inflict Warpwave
O97E3bY0dRr5pLCH.description: An imentesh inflicts a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave} on a creature within 100 feet (@Check[fortitude|dc:38] to resist).

Gy4RoLuOaQU79ESu.name: Sneak Attack
Gy4RoLuOaQU79ESu.description: An imentesh's Strikes deal an additional 4d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} targets.

lZznKQkFobPXBxDT.name: Warpwave Strike
lZznKQkFobPXBxDT.description: Any creature struck and damaged by an imentesh's jaws Strike must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:38] save or be subject to a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.rollable-tables.RollTable.yRZwPolTnRdnz42V]{Warpwave}.

Agradaemon.name: Agradaemon
Agradaemon.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

K287MomJCMfPXPLf.name: Smoke Vision
K287MomJCMfPXPLf.description: Smoke doesn't impair an agradaemon's vision; it ignores the concealed condition from smoke.

SDGB0XLwXRcTWroq.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

n9d7kqBHgMv3tOmv.name: Choking Smog
n9d7kqBHgMv3tOmv.description: 100 feet. The agradaemon is surrounded by ashy smoke. Creatures within the aura are concealed, and creatures outside of it are concealed to creatures within it. Non-daemon creatures can't breathe in the aura and must hold their breath or suffocate.

fC6dc9AdYYKBeuWn.name: Daemonic Pledge
fC6dc9AdYYKBeuWn.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The agradaemon designates a single willing mortal as a pledged fanatic. That creature gains resistance to fire equal to its level, immunity to the agradaemon's choking smog aura, and smoke vision.

The agradaemon can have up to 10 pledged fanatics at one time and can remove the status from any number of pledged fanatics as a free action with the concentrate trait. The status can also be removed with an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.7Fd4lxozd11MQ55N]{Atone} ritual.

pnx6alHWYJ3kLnBW.name: Proven Devotion
pnx6alHWYJ3kLnBW.description:
The agradaemon regains @Damage[15[untyped]] Hit Points, and a pledged fanatic of the agradaemon's choice that it can see loses 15 Hit Points (no effects apply that would decrease this Hit Point loss).

A pledged creature that dies in this way explodes and deals @Damage[9d10[fire]|options:area-damage] damage in a @Template[emanation|distance:20] (@Check[reflex|dc:41|basic|options:area-effect] save).

nCwbF6k6DjALgFuy.name: Rage
nCwbF6k6DjALgFuy.description:
Requirements Bolar isn't fatigued or raging

Effect Bolar gains 3 temporary Hit Points that last until the rage ends. While raging, he deals 2 additional damage with melee attacks and takes a -1 penalty to AC. The rage lasts for 1 minute, until there are no enemies Bolar can perceive, or until Bolar falls unconscious.

Once the rage ends, Bolar can't Rage again for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feat-effects.Item.z3uyCMBddrPK5umr]{Effect: Rage}

Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.name: Kharnas's Lesser Glyph
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.desc (hazard): A hidden glyph suddenly lights up and dominates the mind of any creature not bearing the sigil of Kharnas the Angel-Binder.
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.disable: Disable @Check[thievery|dc:46|name:Destroy Glyph|traits:action:disable-a-device] (legendary) to destroy the glyph, @Check[arcana|dc:42|name:Divert Glyph's Power] (master) to harmlessly divert the glyph's power, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (7th rank; counteract DC 38) to counteract the glyph
Kharnas's Lesser Glyph.reset: The glyph can affect two creatures before it deactivates for 5 minutes and automatically resets.

HGIf9bu9E1RjDKaF.name: Dominate
HGIf9bu9E1RjDKaF.description:
Trigger A creature who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas attempts to open the door

Effect A surge of the Radiant Spark's latent power courses through the glyph and washes over the triggering creature. If the creature is undead, it takes @Damage[10d10[vitality]] damage. If it's living, it instead regains @Damage[10d10[healing]] Hit Points. It then must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:40|traits:incapacitation,mental] save or be affected by a 6th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.OsOhx3TGIZ7AhD0P]{Dominate} spell.

The spell commands the affected creature to attack the nearest creature who doesn't bear the sigil of Kharnas.

rMKwSTFsZNjo251o.name: Dueling Parry
rMKwSTFsZNjo251o.description: As long as he has one free hand, Grimwold can parry attacks against him with his longsword. He gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the start of his next turn as long as his other hand remains free.

I5UOcgBhEV16sOvv.name: Studied Strike
I5UOcgBhEV16sOvv.description: Grimwold studies his foe for weaknesses to exploit. His next successful Strike against that target deals an additional 4d6 precision damage.

Needling Stairs.name: Needling Stairs
Needling Stairs.hpdetails: to break the spring under the step and make that step safe to stand on
Needling Stairs.desc (hazard): This staircase has springs in each step, which send poisoned needles shooting up through tiny holes in the wood when stepped on. Each step, 6 in total, takes up one 5-foot square.
Needling Stairs.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:33|name:Disable Stair Spring|traits:action:disable-a-device] (master) on each stair to disable its spring, or deactivate the switch in area C8 to deactivate the whole trap. Cutting the wire on the topmost stair (>@Check[thievery|dc:35|name:Cut Wire on Top-Most Stair|traits:action:disable-a-device] to Disable the Device) that connects the staircase to the control switch prevents the control switch from turning the trap on or off.
Needling Stairs.reset: If deactivated via the switch, the trap can be reactivated with the switch in area C8.
Needling Stairs.routine: (1 action) The trap makes a separate poisoned needle Strike against each creature currently on an active step as 1 action. Because it is constantly jabbing needles up through any weight-bearing steps, the trap can also use its Bloody Feet free action to jab at a creature on one of the steps during that creature's turn.

fBWMN8Yh6mm05krO.name: First Step
fBWMN8Yh6mm05krO.description:
Trigger A creature ends its movement on one of the stairs

Effect The trap makes a poisoned needle Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

jzOEMi9hAVAe1K1V.name: Poisoned Needle
jzOEMi9hAVAe1K1V.description: No MAP applies to strikes made by poisoned needle attacks

iqSjrlDup1I8i5VX.name: Bloody Feet
iqSjrlDup1I8i5VX.description:
Trigger A creature moves onto an active step

Effect The trap makes a poisoned needle Strike against the triggering creature.

pk7WhgmEvUXgGRiz.name: No MAP
pk7WhgmEvUXgGRiz.description: The Poisoned Needle Strikes do not apply a MAP.

Iron Maiden Trap.name: Iron Maiden Trap
Iron Maiden Trap.desc (hazard): A pressure plate hidden on the floor before an iron maiden causes the torture device to snap shut and trap the triggering creature inside.
Iron Maiden Trap.disable: @Check[thievery|dc:28|name:Disable Pressure Plate|traits:action:disable-a-device] to disable the pressure plate
Iron Maiden Trap.reset: The pressure plate must be reset manually.

Y7LWmp8wJgF4O24C.name: Slam Shut
Y7LWmp8wJgF4O24C.description:
Trigger A creature steps onto the trap's pressure plate (indicated on the map)

Effect The front of the iron maiden slams shut with incredible force and locks itself. The triggering creature takes @Damage[(4d10+10)[piercing]] damage and @Damage[2d6[bleed]] (@Check[reflex|dc:26|basic] save; if the creature critically succeeds, they avoid the trap completely). The triggering creature is also immobilized. The victim can end their immobilization only once a creature outside the iron maiden unlocks the device (requiring two successful [[/act disable-device dc=28]]{DC 28 Thievery} checks to Disable a Device) or breaks the iron maiden, after which the trapped creature must succeed at a DC 25 check to Escape the trap's spike-lined interior.

bLsJ5WlwMamd2QGg.name: Rejuvenation
bLsJ5WlwMamd2QGg.description:
When a graveknight is destroyed, its armor rebuilds its body over the course of [[/gmr 1d10 #days]] days-or more quickly if the armor is worn by a living host. If the body is destroyed before then, the process restarts.

A graveknight can only be permanently destroyed by obliterating its armor (such as with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.r7ihOgKv19eJQnik]{Disintegrate}), transporting it to the Forge of Creation, or throwing it into the heart of a volcano.

1GcnjXs1m3fitCxq.name: Sacrilegious Aura
1GcnjXs1m3fitCxq.description: 30 feet. When a creature in the aura uses a vitality spell or ability, the graveknight automatically attempts to counteract it, with a +27 counteract modifier.

OqEu80bVGGZXPfVs.name: Devastating Blast
OqEu80bVGGZXPfVs.description:
The graveknight unleashes a @Template[cone|distance:30] of energy.

Creatures in the area take @Damage[10d12[fire]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[reflex|dc:37|basic|options:area-effect] save).

The graveknight can't use this ability again for [[/gmr 1d4 #Recharge Devastating Blast]]{1d4 rounds}.

0rqwxWSqNK0Ikmdw.name: Graveknight's Curse
0rqwxWSqNK0Ikmdw.description:
This curse affects anyone who wears a graveknight's armor for at least 1 hour

Saving Throw @Check[will|dc:43|traits:curse] save

Onset 1 hour

Stage 1 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1} and can't remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 2 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 2}, hampered 10, and can't remove the armor (1 day)

Stage 3 dies and transforms into the armor's graveknight

N5zf8LJKXg8KdskQ.name: Kharnas's Blessing
N5zf8LJKXg8KdskQ.description:
The graveknight carves the sigil of Kharnas onto an adjacent @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} creature.

As long as the creature bears the sigil of Kharnas, it takes a -2 status penalty to saving throws against the abilities of any creature that previously served Kharnas, but it can also freely pass through any hazards that can be bypassed by those bearing the sigil of Kharnas, such as Kharnas's glyphs.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.St2QzqQvKN0IaXxG]{Effect: Kharna's Blessing}

bqTN2IAncaogzgo9.name: Weapon Master
bqTN2IAncaogzgo9.description: The graveknight has access to the critical specialization effects of any weapons it wields.

QDbM7WGGXh21h9Xw.name: Nimble Dodge
QDbM7WGGXh21h9Xw.description:
Trigger A creature targets Fayati with an attack and she can see the attacker

Effect Fayati dodges out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

WCFZ8IEU5wGPGAZK.name: Opportune Backstab
WCFZ8IEU5wGPGAZK.description:
Trigger A creature within Fayati's reach is hit by a melee Strike from one of her allies

Effect Fayati makes a Strike against the triggering creature.

4mfr0BXdQQ9ZuRDr.name: Deepen the Wound
4mfr0BXdQQ9ZuRDr.description:
Requirements Fayati's last attack was a successful melee Strike with her rapier

Effect Fayati makes a main-gauche Strike against the same creature that she just hit. This Strike deals an additional 4d6 precision damage.

0Jid4uAhNoUlXWoo.name: Guildmaster's Lead
0Jid4uAhNoUlXWoo.description:
Whenever Fayati critically succeeds at a Strike against a creature, until the start of her next turn, the first time that another member of the Copper Hand deals damage to that creature during their turn, they deal an additional 1d6 precision damage to it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.bestiary-effects.Item.dVVc5MYx4G3QPHoa]{Effect: Guildmaster's Lead}

SriOV0CxqQFmpPCv.name: Sneak Attack
SriOV0CxqQFmpPCv.description: Fayati deals 2d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

deQl75TOphyii6YU.name: Planar Coven
deQl75TOphyii6YU.description: As long as at least one other member of Myrna's coven is on the demiplane of Stormholt, the coven members add chain lightning, lightning bolt, plane shift, and punishing winds to their spells, each of which can be cast at up to 8th level.

byUSs0eF5Ctqs4xY.name: Sea Hag's Bargain
byUSs0eF5Ctqs4xY.description: The sea hag can make a bargain with a willing creature, who must be of sound mind. The creature gives away a special or cherished quality-such as its courage, its beauty, or its voice-in exchange for a boon or a promise from the sea hag. As long as the sea hag keeps her end of the bargain, the only way to restore the lost quality is to defeat the sea hag or make another bargain for its return.

YzsKsO21XfN1KAry.name: Dread Gaze
YzsKsO21XfN1KAry.description:
The hag gazes upon a creature, afflicting it with intense distress and a gnawing sense of impending doom, with a result depending on its @Check[will|dc:37] save. The target does not need to be able to see the sea hag.

Critical Success No effect.

Success @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure Frightened 1 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round. If the target was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.yZRUzMqrMmfLu0V1]{Dying}, it remains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious} for 1 day. At the end of the day, it must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:37] save against the same DC; if it fails, it dies.

Critical Failure @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} and slowed 1 for 1 minute. If the target was dying, it remains unconscious for 1 day. At the end of the day, it must attempt a Fortitude save against the same DC; if it fails, it dies.

Fm6lAJIPw6ObpzHZ.name: Pull Under
Fm6lAJIPw6ObpzHZ.description:
Requirements A creature within 60 feet of Graem or Grinlowe is in contact with the waters of Stormholt

Effect The hag casts maze (DC 37) on the creature, magically pulling the creature beneath the water (regardless of its actual depth) into an extradimensional underwater maze of shipwrecks. Between the two of them, Graem and Grinlowe can have only one creature trapped in the maze, but either hag can use the Sustain a Spell action to sustain the effect.

O6wQ2EWNzgJGn6Ta.name: Hidden Paragon
O6wQ2EWNzgJGn6Ta.description:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger Olansa successfully uses Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.XMcnh4cSI32tljXa]{Hide} and become hidden from all of her current foes, or she uses Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.VMozDqMMuK5kpoX4]{Sneak} and become undetected to all her current foes

Effect Olansa becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} for 1 minute, even if she uses a hostile action. Not even @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.0qaqksrGGDj74HXE]{Revealing Light}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{See the Unseen}, or similar effects can reveal her, though creatures can still use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to locate her.

hbg1FrfQIQ6EAWuz.name: Opportune Backstab
hbg1FrfQIQ6EAWuz.description:
Trigger A creature within Olansa's melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of her allies

Effect Olansa Strikes the triggering creature.

2yp2PpkHqWXuA5k0.name: Change Shape
2yp2PpkHqWXuA5k0.description:
Olansa's true form is that of a monstrous spiderlike daemon. Olansa can still take on her former human appearance. This doesn't change her Speed or her attack and damage modifiers with her Strikes.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.ChangeShape]

RPGIrySxh4Qa0yaP.name: Sneak Attack
RPGIrySxh4Qa0yaP.description: Olansa deals 4d6 extra precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

wPp48cMhLkEqI4UE.name: Binding Blast
wPp48cMhLkEqI4UE.description: A commando's thunderstone is infused with special reagents to produce a blinding flash of light. In addition to the thunderstone's normal effects, creatures that fail the saving throw against the thunderstone are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round. Creatures that critically fail are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round. Creatures who protect their eyes, such as by wearing tinted goggles, are immune to the infused thunderstone's blinding effect.

Eq6IkJnS6klg5Kqj.name: Target Culprit
Eq6IkJnS6klg5Kqj.description: The commando designates a single creature as their culprit. The commando gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} their culprit and a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EA5vuSgJfiHH7plD]{Track} their culprit. The commando's attacks deal an additional 2d8 precision damage to the culprit. This designation lasts for 24 hours or until the commando targets another creature with this ability.

QgE3ujjsFZSthy7z.name: Illusory Copies
QgE3ujjsFZSthy7z.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Blune calls into existence [[/r 1d4+2 #illusory copies]] illusory copies of himself, which dance around him and copy his every movement, making it almost impossible to pinpoint the true Blune.

Any attack that would hit Blune has a random chance of hitting an illusory copy instead. This effect lasts for up to 1 minute or until all the copies are destroyed or Blune is incapacitated.

Once a copy is hit, it's destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit Blune's AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys a copy but has no additional effect (even if the attack would normally have an effect on a failure). If an attack roll is a critical success and would hit a copy, the copy is destroyed and the attack roll becomes a success against Blune.

Once all the copies are destroyed, this ability ends.

WQakf5K0a5EhkRkV.name: Sneak Attack
WQakf5K0a5EhkRkV.description: Blune deals an additional 4d6 precision damage to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} creatures.

vW6qQ6HvTQdopnBl.name: Bloody Sneak Attack
vW6qQ6HvTQdopnBl.description: Any creature taking @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistent Bleed Damage} is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the Skinner's attacks. When attacking an off-guard creature, the Skinner deals an additional 2d6 precision damage.

ZNWERIfXN1fj8u4P.name: Chain Expert
ZNWERIfXN1fj8u4P.description: The Skinner can effectively wield abnormally long spiked chains and can do so using only one hand.

1Rk88GORg0fjreo8.name: Chain Up
1Rk88GORg0fjreo8.description:
Requirements The Skinner has an adjacent creature grabbed with her spiked chain

Effect The Skinner attempts an @Check[athletics|defense:reflex] check against the grabbed creature's Reflex save DC. On a success, the Skinner knots her chain around the grabbed creature, which becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} (Escape DC = 10 + the result of the Skinner's Athletics check); on a critical success, the creature also falls @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

Regardless of whether the Skinner succeeds, she drops the chain.

mIVZhiAlmqc8WWY7.name: Flay
mIVZhiAlmqc8WWY7.description: Whenever the Skinner makes a successful cleaver Strike against a grabbed creature, she also deals @Damage[1d6[bleed]] (or @Damage[2d6[bleed]] on a critical hit).

z53waMQlGY7ahvCA.name: Hook and Flay
z53waMQlGY7ahvCA.description:
Requirements The Skinner has a creature grabbed with her spiked chain

Effect The Skinner pulls the creature into the nearest open adjacent square and makes a cleaver Strike against the creature.

Maurrisa Jonne.name: Maurrisa Jonne
Maurrisa Jonne.saves: +1 status bonus to saves vs. incapacitation effects, +2 status bonus to saves vs. Shove and Trip

yzzm5eV3r1RGpar6.name: +1 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Incapacitation Effects

7vOzE1FHZEotvswQ.name: +2 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Shove

hhg7o2qV6JntAswy.name: +2 Status Bonus on Saves vs. Trip

FvZvIio9Hz2dvltI.name: Duck and Weave
FvZvIio9Hz2dvltI.description:
Trigger A creature misses two consecutive melee Strikes against Maurrisa

Effect Maurrisa takes advantage of a flailing foe's opening. She can either Step 5 feet or make a melee Strike against the triggering creature.

DLJfYIHzmCQGAW0s.name: Rabbit Punch
DLJfYIHzmCQGAW0s.description:
Trigger Maurrisa can make an Attack of Opportunity

Effect Maurrisa chops her opponent on the back of the head or neck, possibly concussing them.

The target must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save. On a failure, the creature takes damage as if hit by Maurrisa's fist Strike, and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}. On a critical failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 3} instead.

YhPJNRCs20xqntX6.name: Motion Sense 60 feet
YhPJNRCs20xqntX6.description: A vaultbreaker ooze can sense nearby motion through vibration and air movement.

efKlG6Tj9bAd6SQ9.name: Treasure Sense (Imprecise) 30 feet
efKlG6Tj9bAd6SQ9.description: The vaultbreaker ooze's metallic plasm alerts it to the presence of metals with the precious trait (including gold and platinum) within 30 feet.

MyTJRF05gqbWnyPq.name: Metallify
MyTJRF05gqbWnyPq.description:
Trigger A creature Strikes the vaultbreaker ooze

Effect The ooze's outer plasm hardens into a protective shell of precious metals. Until the start of its next turn, it gains resistance 5 to physical damage (except adamantine), it has a –5-foot penalty to its Speed, and its pseudopod Strikes gain the versatile S or P weapon trait.

97KS2uPGBbRl3fOQ.name: Engulf
97KS2uPGBbRl3fOQ.description:
@Check[reflex|dc:23|traits:damaging-effect], @Damage[(2d8+9)[acid]] damage, [[/act escape dc=23]], Rupture 14 (19 when using Metallify)

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.Engulf]

BasU6Iuc7hRxhoYG.name: Form Tool
BasU6Iuc7hRxhoYG.description: The vaultbreaker ooze instinctually shapes its pseudopod into a key, lockpick, or tool required to bypass a locking mechanism; it uses this pseudopod as thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2EE4aF4SZpYf0R6H]{Pick a Lock} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.cYdz2grcOcRt4jk6]{Disable a Device}.

The Inkmaster.name: The Inkmaster
The Inkmaster.description:
Shemhazians rise from the souls of torturers and those who reveled in mutilating the physical bodies of their victims. Standing 35 feet tall, a shemhazian is well equipped with a wide range of talons, claws, and fangs to continue inflicting such torments on those it encounters.

Shemhazians delight in visiting torment upon mortals, of course, but more than most demons, these fiends revel in sharing the pain with their own kind. Other demons fear and hate shemhazians for this reason, with only the most powerful willing to work with a shemhazian to achieve a shared goal. Even then, the shemhazian is always on the watch for an opportunity to bring pain and suffering to its allies along with any foe.
The Inkmaster.saves: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

mvXjjQkWwvMJZSer.name: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

l7wT4LDdfJXJETHf.name: Clockwork Brain
l7wT4LDdfJXJETHf.description: A second brain, made of clockwork, is implanted in the Inkmaster's skull. Any time he makes a Will save, he rolls twice and takes the higher result.

EbuMoQ5idyQJDEXD.name: Paralyzing Gaze
EbuMoQ5idyQJDEXD.description: 30 feet. A non-evil creature that ends its turn in the aura must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save. If it fails, it's slowed 1 for 1 round, and if it critically fails, it is instead paralyzed for 1 round.

Tk7abWUpvDDV6Qg0.name: Succor Vulnerability
